companies.name: Ecton
companies.description: Ecton, Inc. is an AI-powered patient payments platform focused on reducing the financial stress and financial toxicity that surround healthcare costs. Its flagship product, Toni, is an AI financial counselor that gives patients personalized guidance on medical bills, insurance, and payment options, paired with a Health Savings and Spending Wallet for managing and paying healthcare expenses. Ecton helps healthcare providers strengthen patient relationships, improve treatment adherence, and increase revenue collection. The company is HIPAA-aligned and backed by General Catalyst. Ecton does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and public security posture.

companies.name: EventX
companies.description: EventX (EventXtra Limited) is an AI-powered, all-in-one event management and marketing platform for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, headquartered in Hong Kong with offices across APAC. It provides event registration and RSVP, QR-code check-in and badge printing, ticketing and payment with 0% platform fees, AI Lead Finder, event website building, virtual event hosting, sponsor and exhibitor management, lead capture, and WhatsApp/email marketing. EventX serves 5,600+ brands and is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. It also offers an official hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query live event data (registrations, sessions, ticket sales, attendance) in natural language, provisioned one-click from the EventX dashboard and compatible with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and OpenCode. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched via the pipeline.

companies.name: IDOVEN
companies.description: Idoven builds artificial-intelligence solutions for cardiovascular care. Its flagship platform, Willem, is a CE-marked Class IIa medical device that analyzes electrocardiograms (ECGs) to detect, diagnose, and monitor cardiac disease, identifying 22 cardiac patterns and 4 intervals across ambulatory devices, diagnostic ECGs, and insertable cardiac monitors. Idoven serves MedTech companies, Life Sciences (cardiotoxicity monitoring and disease-risk scoring for pharma trials), and preventative remote-screening programs. The Willem API supports bi-directional data exchange in EDF, HL7, DICOM, JSON, XML, and PDF. The company is headquartered in Spain, holds an extensive ISO and IEC certification program, and is backed by Insight Partners and Northzone. Sector: healthcare / cardiology AI.

companies.name: Juniper Square
companies.description: Juniper Square is the fund operating system (GPX) for private markets, used by 2,300+ private-markets GPs to raise capital, run fund administration and fund accounting, manage investor relationships through an investor portal, and handle compliance and reporting. It combines connected technology, unified data, fund administration expertise, and AI. For developers it exposes a sales-led developer API with broad read/write coverage across investor data, fund accounting, payments, compliance, and reporting, plus Headless GPX — an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) surface that connects Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any MCP-compatible client to a customer's Juniper Square data under its existing permissions and audit. Sector: fintech / proptech, private markets and commercial real estate investment management.

companies.name: Pair Eyewear
companies.description: Pair Eyewear is a direct-to-consumer eyewear brand known for its modular, magnetic Top Frames system: customers pick a base optical or sunglasses frame and swap interchangeable magnetic top frames in hundreds of patterns and licensed collaborations (Disney, Marvel, MLB, and more). Prescription and blue-light lenses are made and hand-assembled in California, with frames starting around $80, free shipping and 30-day returns, and a Pair+ membership. The paireyewear.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface — a published agents.md and llms.txt, Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

companies.name: Petstore.com
companies.description: Petstore.com is an online pet-supplies store built on Shopify that exposes a first-class agent commerce surface. Alongside the human storefront it implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at /api/ucp/mcp, publishes a /.well-known/ucp merchant profile and a /agents.md (mirrored as /llms.txt) describing how AI agents can search the catalog, build a cart, and drive a buyer-approved checkout. Buyer identity uses Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect, payment is handled by Google Pay and Shopify card handlers, and every checkout requires contemporaneous human approval. Read-only storefront browsing (products, collections, search, sitemap) needs no auth. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio lead; enriched from the store's live agent-facing surface.

companies.name: Rad.

companies.name: HEAVY.AI
companies.description: HEAVY.AI is a GPU-accelerated analytics platform (formerly OmniSci / MapD, now part of NVIDIA) built to interactively query and visualize very large, often geospatial and time-series, datasets. It pairs an open-source, GPU-accelerated SQL database (HeavyDB) with a server-side rendering engine (HeavyRender) and a web-based visual analytics application (Heavy Immerse). Developers interact with the platform through native SQL, an Apache Thrift API, JDBC/ODBC drivers, the heavysql command-line console, a Python data-science client (heavyai) and a JavaScript connector (@heavyai/connector), plus a Vega-based rendering API. companies.name: Infinitus
companies.description: Infinitus Systems is a safety-first healthcare voice AI platform that automates outbound and inbound phone calls to patients, payors, and providers for clinical and administrative tasks including benefit verification, prior authorization, prescription follow-up, and patient engagement. Its products include AI Agents (autonomous call handling), AI Copilots (human-assisted tools), Studio (a no-code agent builder), and Lens (conversation analysis and real-time clinical risk detection), backed by a healthcare knowledge graph. Benefit verification can be invoked as individual or bulk requests through an API, and the platform offers a Salesforce integration, though Infinitus does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI. The company is backed by GV and Kleiner Perkins.

companies.name: Meshcapade
companies.description: Meshcapade builds digital humans - technology that turns images, video, motion capture, body measurements or text prompts into anatomically accurate, animation-ready 3D avatars. Its platform is built on the SMPL, SMPL-X and SUPR parametric body-model family that originated at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in Tuebingen, Germany. Meshcapade offers a hosted avatar-creation platform at me.meshcapade.com and a REST API for programmatic avatar generation, plus open-source body-model libraries and integrations for Blender, Maya and Unreal Engine. Customers span fashion, robotics, gaming and animation, fitness, and scientific research.

companies.name: Mito Ai
companies.description: Mito (Saga, Inc. / Sagacollab) is a suite of Jupyter and JupyterLab extensions that help data professionals write Python code faster. It combines Mito AI (a context-aware chat agent, autocomplete, and smart debugging), the Mito Spreadsheet (an Excel-like interface that generates equivalent Python/pandas code as you edit, pivot, filter, and graph), database connectors, and one-click deployment of notebooks as Streamlit and Dash apps. Mito is distributed as open-source Python packages (mitosheet, mito-ai) installable via pip and ships an official Mito AI MCP server for connecting the Mito Agent to MCP-capable clients. It is not a hosted REST API product; the developer surface is the client libraries, the MCP server, and the Jupyter tooling. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

companies.name: Modelcode
companies.description: Modelcode AI builds Morph, an AI-powered code modernization platform that transforms legacy software into modern, maintainable codebases. Morph plans, executes, tests, and verifies complex migrations — language upgrades, language translations (COBOL to Java, Ada to C++, Python 2 to 3), framework migrations (AngularJS to React, Express to FastAPI), dependency modernization, and monolith-to-microservices decomposition — while keeping engineering teams in control through project specifications, incremental milestones, pull requests, and measurable acceptance criteria. Build and test workflows run in Modelcode-hosted sandboxes or via a self-hosted ModelDaemon inside a customer's own environment for apps that depend on private services and internal infrastructure. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

companies.name: Zocks
companies.description: Zocks is an AI assistant for financial advisors that captures client conversations and automates the administrative side of advice — meeting note-taking with speaker attribution, meeting preparation, intake and account form filling, client email drafting, document intelligence, and centralized client/household profiles. Captured client intelligence syncs across CRM and wealth-management systems including Wealthbox, HubSpot, Salesforce, Redtail, Practifi, eMoney, and Orion, with Zoom and Google Meet as meeting sources. Rather than a public REST API, Zocks exposes this intelligence to AI tools through an official hosted MCP server secured with OAuth 2.0 over Streamable HTTP, installable as a connector in Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot with tool-call-level audit logging. The company is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Sector: fintech / wealthtech.

companies.name: Fountain
companies.description: Fountain is an AI-powered frontline workforce platform that helps high-volume employers source, screen, hire, onboard, schedule, and retain hourly workers across quick-service restaurants, retail, logistics, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing, grocery, and franchise operations. The integrated product suite spans an applicant tracking system, candidate CRM, agentic sourcing ("Source"), digital onboarding with document collection and background-check integrations, shift and scheduling for active workers, and an orchestration layer called Cue that automates workflows across all products. AI agents Anna (recruiter screening), Emma (24/7 candidate support), and Sam (employee engagement) sit across the funnel and the post-hire workforce. Fountain exposes a versioned REST API at developer.fountain.com covering the Hire API (applicants, funnels/openings, stages, calendar slots, labels, custom exports, webhooks) and the post-hire Worker API (worker profiles, employment records, document submissions, I-9 verification, attendance, shifts, demands, breaks, and holidays), with authentication via the X-ACCESS-TOKEN header on per-tenant base URLs or OAuth 2.0 through the unified services.fountain.com hire service base URL for partner integrations.

companies.name: Gradient Health
companies.description: Gradient Health is a multimodal medical data company that accelerates medical AI development by giving AI developers secure, self-service access to diverse, de-identified medical imaging data. Its Atlas platform lets teams search a catalog of 20M+ de-identified imaging studies across hundreds of DICOM tags with longitudinal, patient-level search, construct representative cohorts, and export full DICOM datasets. Gradient Health sources, de-identifies, curates, and delivers data from a network of healthcare data partners, and is HIPAA compliant and AICPA SOC 2 certified. First-party open-source tooling supports cloud-optimized DICOM storage, parsing, and TensorFlow decode operations.

companies.name: Lingvist
companies.description: Lingvist is an Estonian education technology company building an AI-powered language-learning platform that uses machine learning, language statistics and spaced repetition to teach the vocabulary a learner actually needs. It was founded by Mait Müntel, a physicist who worked on the Higgs boson discovery team at CERN and built the first prototype to teach himself French. Lingvist maps each learner's knowledge in real time and adapts course material to them individually, offering 60+ courses across 15+ languages, a Custom Decks feature that turns a learner's own words or texts into a course, and a Lingvist for Business offering. Lingvist does not operate a public, self-serve API program - no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published. It does run an OAuth 2.0 protected API at api.lingvist.com whose endpoints are publicly documented only through Lingvist's own open-source NodeBB single-sign-on plugin, with client credentials arranged directly with Lingvist rather than self-registered.

companies.name: Amboras
companies.description: Amboras is an AI-native e-commerce platform - positioned as "the AI-native Shopify" - that puts an entire online store on autopilot. Merchants build or rebuild a storefront by talking to AI in natural language, and Amboras then autonomously generates design, copy, and product imagery, runs generative A/B tests, adjusts pricing and offers, and reads first-party analytics to continuously optimize conversion rate, retention, and average order value. It includes integrated checkout via Stripe and PayPal and first-party session, funnel, and revenue tracking with no third-party pixels. Founded in 2025 in San Francisco by Imad and Amin Mokadem, Amboras is a Y Combinator Spring 2026 (P26) company. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation - this record captures its public web and product surface only.

Its API ecosystem is now consolidated under the global Getnet Docs portal (docs.globalgetnet.com) with a Single Entry Point (SEP) Regional API alongside Web Checkout, Marketplace, Payment Link, Chargeback, Onboarding, in-store terminal integrations (App2App, Host-to-Host, Integrated POS, Cloud-to-Cloud), and an emerging Agentic Commerce / MCP AI Toolkit surface for AI-driven payments. The Brazilian developer hub at developers.getnet.com.br is being migrated to the unified global portal.

companies.name: Opendoor

Aline syncs documents from Google Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, and Box, and is a Techstars-backed company. This profile was enriched from Aline's public product surface; Aline publishes no public developer API, so this repo captures its identity, changelog, trust center, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Bolt.new
companies.description: Bolt.new is StackBlitz's in-browser AI full-stack app builder. From a natural language prompt it generates, edits, runs, and deploys complete web applications inside the user's browser tab using StackBlitz's WebContainer runtime — a WebAssembly-based Node.js operating system that boots a real filesystem, npm/pnpm/yarn package manager, terminal, and live preview without a remote VM. The product targets product managers, entrepreneurs, marketers, agencies, and non-engineer builders with conversational app creation, design-system import from Figma and component libraries (Material UI, Chakra UI, Shadcn/ui), built-in database and authentication, one-click deploy to Netlify or bolt.host, custom domains, GitHub version control, and integrations with Supabase, Stripe, Expo, and MCP servers. Bolt.new itself is a hosted, UI-driven product metered in monthly AI tokens with Free, Pro, Teams, and Enterprise tiers — there is no public REST/HTTP developer API or CLI. StackBlitz separately ships the WebContainer API as a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (npm @webcontainer/api) for embedding the same in-browser dev environment in third-party sites, plus a StackBlitz SDK (@stackblitz/sdk) for programmatically opening projects. The Bolt.new reference codebase is open source under MIT at github.com/stackblitz/bolt.new as a foundation for building custom AI dev agents; the hosted commercial product is closed source.

Datapad is a San Francisco company backed by a16z. companies.name: Hireology

The platform spans the full hiring lifecycle — candidate sourcing and job distribution, applicant engagement and texting, structured screening and skills assessments, interview and evaluation workflows, hiring decisions, and onboarding handoff — plus reporting and analytics that help operators hire consistently, faster, and at scale across locations. Hireology integrates with payroll, HRIS, background-check, scheduling, and job-board partners such as ADP, UKG, BambooHR, Indeed, CDK, Dealertrack, and Accurate. companies.description: Lovable is an AI app builder that generates full-stack web applications from natural- language prompts, with live preview, GitHub sync, and Supabase / Firebase integration. Lovable's developer-facing surface is in early release: the "Build with URL" API generates apps from a shareable URL, and the Lovable MCP Server lets AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) manage Lovable projects via Model Context Protocol.

companies.name: Perseus
companies.description: Perseus (legal name Efficient Systems Inc.) is an applied AI lab focused on semantic search in latent spaces, founded by Samrath Chadha and backed by Y Combinator (Fall 2025 batch). Its first product is a retrieval engine that grounds coding agents in real code: developers and agents describe the code they are looking for in plain English and Perseus returns ranked file:line results with snippets in seconds, indexing the working tree (including uncommitted edits) so models like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex can find the right context before editing. Rather than a public REST API, Perseus ships a first-party CLI (installed via a curl/PowerShell one-liner, as a PyInstaller binary or uv wheel), a provider-published Agent Skill, and a Factory Droid plugin, all under the efficientsystemsinc GitHub organization. The developer surface — docs, console, pricing, and blog — is live; there is no OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery document published as of this pass.

companies.name: Savant Labs
companies.description: Savant Labs is an agentic AI platform for business analytics, finance, and data automation. It turns AI conversations into governed, audit-ready agents that automate regulated finance workflows such as month-end close, reconciliations, tax automation, and financial consolidation, with human review and audit-ready evidence. The no-code platform combines data preparation, blending, cleansing, automation, and a Vision Agent that extracts data from PDFs and images, connecting to ERPs (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), data warehouses, BI tools, and spreadsheets through hundreds of pre-built connectors. Savant Labs is SOC 2 Type II certified with GDPR and HIPAA support, and is used by teams at Dell Technologies, ConocoPhillips, and Rover. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta.

companies.name: Spekit
companies.description: Spekit is an AI-powered revenue enablement platform for B2B sales teams, delivering coaching, content, and deal intelligence inside rep workflows. Its GTM Knowledge Engine keeps governed go-to-market knowledge accurate and on-brand, pairs agentic coaching (the AI Sidekick) with unified deal context from Salesforce, Gong, and email, and generates personalized buyer experiences such as automated deal rooms. Spekit exposes its governed knowledge to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so any LLM or MCP-enabled tool always has the latest content. It is SOC 2 Type II audited and integrates across Salesforce, Slack, Gmail, Outlook, HubSpot, and major SSO providers. Spekit does not publish a public developer REST API; its programmatic surface is the MCP server plus SaaS integrations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Craft Ventures, Felicis, and Foundry Group and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

companies.description: Google DeepMind is an artificial intelligence research laboratory and product organization behind the Gemini and Gemma foundation model families, the AlphaFold protein-structure prediction system, WeatherNext atmospheric forecasting, and Gemini Robotics. Founded in London and now part of Google, DeepMind combines frontier AI research with public and developer-facing model deployment. Its models are exposed to developers through the Google AI / Gemini API and Google AI Studio, while its research tooling ships as first-party open-source JAX libraries (Haiku, Optax, Chex, dm-control, and more) on GitHub and PyPI. Originally an independent startup backed by early investors including Founders Fund before its acquisition by Google.

companies.name: Ferry
companies.description: Ferry (operated by ThirdRails Ltd) is a London-based development and data integration platform for the industrial edge, founded in 2023 by Dominic Aits and Ethan Waldie. Ferry lets operations, IT and data teams in operationally intensive industries — manufacturing, energy, oil & gas and pharmaceuticals — integrate data from factory floors and frontline operations directly into their IT systems, and build, deploy and monitor custom edge applications and data pipelines on industrial hardware. It ships as a modular Manufacturing Execution System (MES) with agentic AI for production scheduling, supply chain operations, troubleshooting, real-time process guidance and continuous improvement, deploying via AWS IoT Greengrass in the customer's own AWS account or Azure IoT Edge in their Azure account. Ferry is backed by Seedcamp, Asymmetric Capital Partners and Target Global, and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

companies.name: Juniper Square
companies.description: Juniper Square is a fund operating system for the private markets, used by 2,300+ general partners across private equity, venture capital, commercial real estate, and private credit to raise capital, run fund administration and fund accounting, and manage the LP experience. Its GPX platform unifies investor data, fund accounting, payments, compliance, and reporting, and exposes them through a developer API (broad read/write coverage delivered as a developer-led engagement), pre-built connectors (HubSpot, Preqin, Outlook, DocuSign, Yardi IM/Voyager, Lob), and Headless GPX — an MCP server that brings the platform to any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini) with authentication, permissions, and audit inherited from the customer's existing configuration.

companies.name: CallSign
companies.description: Callsign is a digital trust platform for fraud prevention, authentication, and identity intelligence. Its Intelligence Engine combines behavioral biometrics, device fingerprinting, telco intelligence, and threat ensembling with an orchestration layer that applies dynamic interventions across customer journeys - login and access, online payments, account creation, and Zero Trust network access - to recognize and authenticate users passively. The Authentication Suite (Callsign One) delivers passwordless, low-friction authentication, and the platform targets account takeover, social engineering and scams, malware and bots, SIM swap, call divert, and synthetic identity. Callsign integrates via REST APIs and web and mobile SDKs, and is certified to ISO/IEC 27001 with SOC 2 attestation. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Accel portfolio and enriched from Callsign's public developer surface.

companies.name: Outerbounds
companies.description: Outerbounds is a fully managed platform for building and deploying production-grade AI, ML, and data systems, built on the open-source Metaflow framework originally developed at Netflix. It brings data, models, and agents together with software discipline: scalable, cost-efficient compute integrated with a customer's existing cloud and data platforms, GPU access and autoscaling, consistent offline/online runtimes, and enterprise controls including SOC 2 and HIPAA. The developer surface is the Metaflow Python SDK and the outerbounds configuration CLI rather than a public REST API. Outerbounds is joining Anaconda.

companies.name: Pi Labs
companies.description: Pi Labs (withpi.ai) is an applied-AI company, backed by Accel and later acquired by Microsoft, that builds tooling to evaluate and enhance AI applications. Its core product, Pi Scorer, is a deterministic, roughly 200ms foundation model that scores any text against a rubric of natural-language questions — reported to be about 500x more efficient than using an LLM as a judge. Teams use it to calibrate rubrics, gate and rank LLM outputs, and close the loop across training, inference, and feedback. The scoring engine is exposed as an OpenAPI-compatible REST API at api.withpi.ai with official Python and TypeScript SDKs (both published as "withpi"), a copilot for building scoring specs, and a Promptfoo integration (Pi Scorer).

companies.name: Procurement Sciences
companies.description: Procurement Sciences is an AI platform for government contractors that automates the full capture-to-contract lifecycle — opportunity search and bid/no-bid analysis, competitive intelligence and capture planning, compliant proposal generation and AI-assisted drafting, and post-award contract and recompete management — across federal, state, and local markets. The company reports serving 3,000+ businesses, including nearly 50% of the Top 100 government contractors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Procurement Sciences publishes no public developer API surface; this profile is enriched from its public website and its security & compliance (Trust Portal) disclosures — SOC 2 Type II, CMMC Level 2, FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and FIPS 140-2.

SeekOut is used by 750+ customers including Microsoft, DocuSign, Sony, and Thomson Reuters.

companies.name: AskSenti
companies.description: AskSenti (SentiSum) is an AI-native customer experience (CX) intelligence platform that reads every customer conversation across support, survey, and social channels through its "Kyo" AI engine, identifies what is breaking and why, quantifies the dollar impact, and flags churn before it costs revenue. It ships three agents — an Early Warning Agent for real-time anomaly detection, an Insights Agent for root-cause analysis and dollar-impact quantification, and a Quality Agent for conversation scoring and CSAT prediction — over Unified Signals that consolidate the voice of the customer. Delivered as hosted SaaS with 100+ inbound integrations (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce, and more); it is SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR compliant. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API is published today.

companies.name: Balto
companies.description: Balto is a contact center AI platform that pairs live human agents with real-time AI to improve conversation quality, compliance, efficiency, and revenue. Its unified system delivers real-time agent guidance (Agent Assist), automated quality assurance that auto-scores 100% of interactions, real-time compliance monitoring and risk alerting, AI coaching, call summarization (Real-Time Notetaker), omnichannel voice and digital support, and a Voice AI Agent (Togo) for high-volume repeatable calls. Balto integrates with 50+ contact center (CCaaS) platforms including Five9, Genesys, Amazon Connect, NICE inContact, RingCentral, and Convoso, and exposes a Call Data API for exporting historical call records into external systems and data warehouses. Founded in St. Louis, Balto is backed by Sierra Ventures. This profile was enriched from Balto's public web surface; the developer documentation at docs.balto.ai sits behind an authenticated login, so no public OpenAPI was available to harvest.

companies.name: Connect-RPC
companies.description: Connect is a slim framework for building browser-friendly and gRPC-compatible HTTP APIs from Protocol Buffer schemas. Servers built with Connect speak the Connect protocol, gRPC, and gRPC-Web simultaneously, while clients can switch between protocols without changing code. Connect provides type-safe SDKs for Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, and Python, plus the Buf-generated `protoc-gen-connect-*` code generators. The project is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and is maintained by Buf.

companies.name: evinced
companies.description: Evinced is an AI-powered digital accessibility platform that automatically detects, clusters, tracks, and prevents accessibility (WCAG/ADA) issues across web and mobile applications. It ships developer-first automation SDKs for Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, WebdriverIO, TestCafe, Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest, plus Web and Mobile Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, VS Code, Continue) query accessibility advice and run automated remediation in-flow. Backed by Insight Partners, Evinced is used by Amazon, Capital One, Verizon, and Hyundai.

companies.name: HYCU
companies.description: HYCU is an AI-powered data resilience and data protection platform that backs up, protects, and recovers more than 100 workloads across on-premises, public cloud, and SaaS environments. Its R-Cloud platform is delivered as a low-code data protection development platform that lets SaaS and AI application providers rapidly build and publish backup-and-recovery services to the R-Cloud Marketplace, alongside R-Shield for ransomware threat prevention and recoverability validation and aiR for querying backup data as an intelligence source. HYCU serves 4,800+ organizations across 78 countries and is recognized as a Leader by IDC and Gartner. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; HYCU exposes a low-code developer platform rather than a public REST API.

companies.name: Konfig
companies.description: Konfig is an SDK and API documentation generator that turns an OpenAPI Specification or Postman Collection into production-ready client libraries, interactive reference docs, demos, and tutorials. It generates and publishes idiomatic SDKs across TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, PHP, Ruby, Go, Swift, Kotlin, Objective-C, and Dart, republishing them automatically whenever the spec changes, and adds spec linting and generated SDK tests to keep client libraries in sync across the API lifecycle. Konfig is driven from a CLI (konfig-cli) and a konfig.yaml config that calls Konfig's hosted generation backend - it is a developer-tooling platform, not a hosted public REST API of its own. Konfig was sunset in December 2024 and its full codebase was open-sourced (MIT) at github.com/konfig-dev/konfig; the marketing site, docs, and 491 generated SDK repositories at github.com/konfig-sdks remain online.

companies.name: LF AI and Data
companies.description: The LF AI & Data Foundation is a Linux Foundation umbrella that advances open source artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data projects. It hosts 80+ projects spanning graduated, incubation, and sandbox stages, including ONNX, Milvus, Horovod, Flyte, Kedro, Pyro, Egeria, OpenLineage, Marquez, and the Adversarial Robustness Toolbox, fostering scalable, trustworthy, and interoperable AI and data solutions.

companies.name: Maze
companies.description: Maze is a continuous product-discovery and user-research platform that lets product teams run usability tests, prototype tests, surveys, card sorts, tree tests, and live interviews at scale, then turn the results into shareable, research-grade insight. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in London, Maze integrates with design tools like Figma and collaboration tools like Slack, Notion, and Jira, and layers research-grade AI over its testing and reporting surface. The company is venture-backed (Amplify Partners, Emergence Capital, Felicis, General Catalyst, Partech, Seedcamp) and operates a SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR-aligned SaaS. Maze does not currently publish a public developer REST API; its extensibility is delivered through first-party product integrations and SSO. This profile captures Maze's identity, security posture, and operational surface for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Onepot
companies.description: Onepot (onepot.ai) is a San Francisco-based startup building an AI-powered, fully automated custom synthesis platform for small-molecule drug discovery. It combines ultra-high-throughput lab automation in its POT-1 lab with an AI organic chemist ("Phil") and reaction foundation models to search, quote, and synthesize make-on-demand molecules end to end, aiming to replace slow, error-prone CRO workflows. Onepot exposes a developer API and a Python client (published on PyPI as "onepot") that lets teams run Tanimoto similarity and SMILES/SMARTS substructure search over the full onepot CORE compound space, perform retrosynthetic decomposition with building-block and price/risk filters, stream real-time results over server-sent events, and place synthesis orders programmatically from their own pipelines using an API key.

companies.name: Quantexa
companies.description: Quantexa provides decision intelligence solutions using entity resolution and network analytics to help organizations connect disparate data and make better decisions across financial crime, risk, customer intelligence, and public sector use cases.

companies.name: RamAIn
companies.description: RamAIn builds AI agents that automate any UI task with natural language. A Y Combinator (W26) company backed by General Catalyst and Nexus Venture Partners, RamAIn operates web portals, desktop apps, and legacy systems the way a human does — reading screens and interacting with UI elements — then compiles those workflows into reusable, self-healing automations that can be published and managed as APIs. It targets high-friction, document-heavy back-office work across mortgage, finance, healthcare, and insurance.

companies.name: Sword
companies.description: Sword Health is a digital health company delivering AI-powered virtual care for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain, pelvic health, and injury prevention. Founded in 2015 in Portugal by Virgilio Bento, Sword pairs licensed physical therapists with motion-sensor and computer-vision technology so members can complete clinically supervised physical therapy from home. Its platform spans an enrollment platform, a treatment platform, a mobile application backed by a mobile API, a file-exchange platform for enterprise clients, and an AI care system. Sword serves 1,000+ enterprise and health-plan clients across three continents, is backed by investors including General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, and Transformation Capital, and maintains SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, ISO 13485, HIPAA, GDPR, and Cyber Essentials compliance. Sword does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its identity, status, security, and compliance surface.

companies.name: Champ Ai

The platform targets regulated, operations-heavy verticals such as healthcare and professional employer organizations (PEO), claiming 95%+ accuracy on complex standard operating procedures and 4-10x ROI on operational spend. Founded by Jagannath Putrevu, Ted Cheng, and Peter Lin (early Instacart operators), Champ AI emerged from stealth in May 2026 with an $8.5M seed round led by Redpoint Ventures with participation from defy.vc and SV Angel. This profile was surfaced as a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company and enriched from the company's public website; Champ AI does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: Kalepa
companies.description: Kalepa is a New York–headquartered insurtech founded in 2018 by Paul Monasterio and Daniel Hillman that builds Copilot, an AI underwriting workbench sold to commercial property and casualty carriers, MGAs, mutuals and brokers in its home market of the United States. Copilot covers the commercial underwriting workflow end to end — submission ingestion out of broker email and document packages (ACORD forms, statements of value, loss runs, supplemental applications), clearance and sanctions screening, triage by bindability and profitability, risk analysis, rating, quote and bind document generation, and portfolio management. Its API posture is partner-gated and there is no public API. Kalepa publishes no developer portal — developer.kalepa.com, developers.kalepa.com and docs.kalepa.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer, /partners and /integrations on kalepa.com all return 404. A production API host does exist at api.kalepa.com and a "Kalepa API" component is monitored on the company status page, but every documentation path on it returns 404 and the application at copilot.kalepa.com redirects to api.kalepa.com/auth/login, so the only integration surface is behind a customer login negotiated in a commercial deal. The only technical posture Kalepa publishes sits on its For IT/AI Leaders page — an "API-first platform" claim, a 4-6 week production deployment, and SOC 2 Type II, the single certification named anywhere on the site. Its open source is real but unrelated to the product API: two PyPI packages (safe-init, marshmallow-fastoneofschema) and 24 Terraform modules in the public HashiCorp registry, all infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs. ACORD appears only as an ingested document format, not as an implemented data standard — no ACORD XML, AL3, NGDS, IVANS download, Applied Epic or Vertafore integration is documented anywhere on the public site. Kalepa is a clean example of the US insurance seam: no federal regulator, no open-insurance mandate, and therefore nothing forcing a vendor in the underwriting layer to expose anything publicly.

companies.name: VillageSQL
companies.description: VillageSQL is an open-source, drop-in replacement for MySQL 8.4 that adds an extension framework (VEF) for custom SQL functions, custom data types, and custom indexes — capabilities MySQL lacks natively. Extensions install at runtime via SQL (INSTALL EXTENSION) with no server restart, and official extensions cover AI prompting and embeddings, UUIDs, crypto, network address types, HTTP clients, vectors, trigram search, and an embedded REST server. It is distributed as a server binary, Docker image, and one-line installer, with a Rust VEF SDK, C++/Rust extension templates, and provider-published agent skills.

companies.name: Callab AI
companies.description: Callab AI, built by Clusterlabs, is a cloud-based voice AI platform that connects directly to legacy on-premises PBX/SBC telephony (Cisco UCM, Mitel, FreeSWITCH) via SIP trunk integration, routing calls to AI voice agents with no rip-and-replace migration. The platform automates up to 70% of inbound and outbound call volume across support, sales, and scheduling, with no-code agent building, live human supervision and takeover, semantic knowledge bases, post-call transcription and sentiment analysis, CRM data extraction, and batch outbound campaigns. Callab AI exposes a REST API at docs.callab.ai for programmatic control of agents and calls. A Y Combinator Spring 2026 company founded in 2024, it serves hospitality, logistics, retail, and property management across three continents.

companies.name: Deloitte
companies.description: Deloitte is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating through a network of member firms coordinated by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited (DTTL). The organization spans approximately 150 countries and territories, has more than 180 years of history (founded 1845), and serves roughly 90% of the Fortune Global 500. Deloitte organizes delivery across four primary service lines — Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Tax, and Legal — plus specialized cross-functional practices including Business Process Solutions and Global Employer Services. Consulting offerings cover Customer, Cyber, Engineering / AI & Data, Enterprise Technology & Performance, Finance Transformation, Human Capital, Strategy & Transactions, and Risk / Regulatory & Forensic. Deloitte Digital is the technology-and-experience practice with alliances spanning Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, Google Cloud, AWS, ServiceNow, Oracle, Shopify, Sitecore, and Genesys, and accelerators such as FrontOffice Advantage, Revenue Advantage, Agentic Marketing Cloud, CreativEdge, Blueprint, Content Studios, and TrustID. The organization serves six industries divided into twenty sectors: Consumer; Energy, Resources & Industrials; Financial Services; Government & Public Services; Life Sciences & Health Care; and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. Deloitte Insights is the organization's research-publishing surface, organized into eight research centers — Cross-Industry, Economics, Consumer, Energy & Industrials, Financial Services, Government & Public Services, Life Sciences & Health Care, and Tech, Media & Telecom — producing flagship series including Tech Trends, Global Human Capital Trends, Digital Media Trends, TMT Predictions, FSI Predictions, the Weekly Global Economic Outlook, and the annual Industry Outlooks. The Deloitte AI Institute drives applied-AI research and points of view. Deloitte does not publish a public developer API or open developer portal at the corporate level. The Deloitte US Consulting GitHub organization is small (5 visible repositories, mostly archived upstream forks; the original artifact is `beacon`, a first-party web-analytics packaging library in TypeScript). Reader-facing distribution flows through MyDeloitte (personalized content + newsletter subscriptions), Dbriefs (live webcasts with CPE credit), the Deloitte Insights Magazine, and the YouTube channel; no public RSS index page was discoverable on www.deloitte.com at the path published in legacy archives.

companies.name: Fly By Jing
companies.description: Fly By Jing is a premium Chinese food brand founded by James Beard Award-winning chef and entrepreneur Jing Gao in 2018, best known for its small-batch Sichuan Chili Crisp made in Chengdu without preservatives or added sugar. The company sells its signature sauces, noodles, gift sets, and pantry staples direct-to-consumer through a Shopify-powered storefront at flybyjing.com. From an API Evangelist perspective, the storefront exposes a real, live machine surface: a Shopify Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs) and a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, discoverable via the domain's /.well-known/openid-configuration document. Surfaced originally as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched here from live discovery probes of the store domain.

companies.description: Tripo3D (by VAST) is an AI 3D generation platform with text-to-3D, image-to-3D, mesh refinement, and texturing APIs producing game-ready 3D assets. The Tripo API uses an async task-based REST pattern at https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/openapi/task. Authenticate with API key.

companies.name: Ambience
companies.description: Ambience Healthcare builds an AI operating system for healthcare that reduces clinician administrative burden and protects revenue integrity at the point of care. Its ambient AI platform performs real-time medical encounter transcription, clinical note generation, integrated clinical documentation improvement (CDI) with ICD-10 coding suggestions, and EHR patient-context enrichment across more than 100 specialties in outpatient, emergency, and inpatient settings. The platform integrates directly with major EHRs including Epic, Oracle Cerner, and athenahealth. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, Ambience is backed by roughly $370M in funding, including a $243M Series C co-led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Oak HC/FT. Ambience exposes a gated Integration API (documentation and access granted on request via emr-integration@ambiencehealthcare.com) rather than a public self-serve developer program.

companies.name: Archy
companies.description: Archy is an all-in-one, cloud-based dental practice management platform that consolidates scheduling, clinical charting, imaging, insurance verification, billing, patient communication, online payments, and reporting into a single system, layered with AI agents (Scribe for clinical notes, Revenue for insurance claim posting, Intelligence for analytics, and Verify for real-time insurance verification) that automate routine practice workflows. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Rat and Benjamin Kolin and backed by TCV, Bessemer Venture Partners, CRV, and Entree Capital, Archy has raised roughly $47M through a 2025 Series B and serves tens of thousands of active users across dental practices. As a handler of protected health information it is HIPAA-compliant, publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center, and ships native iOS and Android apps. Archy exposes no public developer API; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network for identity, security, and discoverability coverage.

companies.name: Canary Technologies
companies.description: Canary Technologies is an AI-powered hospitality management platform trusted by more than 20,000 hotels across 90+ countries, including brands such as Marriott International, Four Seasons, Choice Hotels, Wyndham, and IHG. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, Canary provides digital guest management — contactless mobile check-in/checkout, tablet registration, upsells, guest messaging, digital tipping, and Canary AI — along with PCI-compliant secure transactions and fraud prevention. The company maintains its own integration tooling and a partner/enterprise API that connects to 80+ property-management, payment, and hospitality systems (Oracle Hospitality, Mews, Cloudbeds, Sabre, Adyen, Shift4, and others), launching 5-10 new integrations per quarter. Canary does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI; API access is granted to hotel partners and integration providers.

companies.description: Clara is an AI-powered primary care and longevity practice, founded by the team behind Circle Medical and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026) and A.Capital. Clara pairs deep clinical AI with board-certified clinician review: it securely imports and analyzes a patient's medical records, surfaces health trends, assists with symptom assessment, medication refills, lab ordering, and longevity/biomarker goals, and routes every medical recommendation to a licensed clinician for review and approval before it reaches the patient. The company operates as a fully licensed primary care practice across all 50 U.S. states and is a HIPAA-covered entity. Clara is a consumer telehealth product (subscription plans on askclara.com) and currently publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public identity, trust, and compliance surface for the API Evangelist network.

Its Participant API and official client SDKs for JavaScript, iOS, Android, PHP and React allocate visitors to experiment variants, deliver optimized configurations, and ingest behavioral events so AI-driven optimization can evolve web and app experiences without manual A/B-test management. Enterprises use Evolv AI to automate conversion-rate optimization and personalization across their digital properties.

companies.description: Maker (maker.co) provides AI code, content, and design agents for your website. Describe what you want in plain language and Maker designs it, codes it, and serves it live on your existing site — landing pages, product pages, A+ product content, personalized and location-based experiences, A/B variants, and Figma imports — with no developers, agencies, or rebuild required. Maker exposes a hosted, OAuth-secured MCP (Model Context Protocol) server at ai.maker.co/mcp so AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Codex can create, edit, publish, and analyze Maker projects directly. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: MeetAndy AI
companies.description: MeetAndy (operated by MeetTomorrow Inc.) is an AI project assistant — an "AI teammate" that lives in Slack, Google Chat, GitHub, GitLab, and Jira and turns plain-language requests into reviewable plans, opens pull requests, runs CI, and reports back. Its Coding Agent writes the code Andy plans and hands off work to human review, while Team Memory preserves architectural decisions and conventions as searchable context. MeetAndy exposes an agent-native surface rather than a public REST API: a hosted MCP server (hub.meetandy.ai) for external tools like Claude Code to read tasks and Spaces, a published llms.txt, and public Claude Code Agent Skills. companies.name: Motics Technologies
companies.description: Motics Technologies (trading as Motics / Motics Health) is a UK-based healthcare AI automation platform providing AI agents for clinics, hospitals, and care homes. Its five agents — Scribe (clinical notes, letters, discharge summaries), Phone (24/7 AI receptionist and appointment booking), Email (patient communications and inbox triage), Billing (insurance claims and revenue cycle management), and Audit (clinic-wide documentation review for CQC/HCPC readiness) — help clinicians save 2+ hours per day on administrative work. Motics serves NHS trusts, private clinics, care homes, and telehealth providers, integrating with practice management systems including Cliniko, Meddbase, and Nookal, and states NHS Digital, HCPC, GMC, CQC, GDPR, and ISO 27001 compliance. The company is a Techstars portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or API reference is published at this time.

companies.description: Octane AI is an AI-powered quiz and product-recommendation platform for Shopify merchants, turning storefront browsers into buyers with no-code personalized quizzes, zero-party data capture, and its CORE-1 recommendation engine. It integrates with 50+ marketing, CRM, and automation tools (Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, Recharge, Gorgias, Zapier, Alloy) and syncs shopper data in real time. Its developer surface is client-side rather than a public REST API: an embeddable quiz widget that dispatches a documented set of browser JavaScript events (octane.quiz.*), custom CSS/JS injection hooks, a headless-store integration path, and a per-account API key plus webhook secret used for integrations and outbound webhook verification. Backed by Bullpen Capital and General Catalyst.

Founded by TJ Ademiluyi (CEO) and Adun Akanni (COO), Alaffia raised a $55M Series B in February 2026 and is backed by FirstMark, Anthemis, and Transformation Capital. The company raised a $5.8M seed round led by Susa Ventures and Box Group with participation from Y Combinator.

The platform spans Companion, Navigator, Runtime, webFrame, Network, and a CLI, and its first shipping product is a macOS desktop app for Apple Silicon Macs offering on-device Chat, Personas, Messages, Contacts, and Artifacts that can run fully offline.

companies.name: BITE Data

The platform is offered as self-service web tooling (Standard, Pro, Business) with Enterprise ERP/TMS integration via secure API feeds; there is no public developer API specification at this time.

The product is delivered as a web app, a Chrome extension, and a Homebrew-distributed desktop application, and supports 26+ languages. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, distribution, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

The Glass platform combines large language model reasoning with curated, physician-reviewed clinical guidelines to generate ranked differential diagnoses, evidence-based assessment and plans, chart summaries, and direct answers to clinical questions ("Consult"), all delivered with inline citations. Glass also provides ambient scribing that listens during patient encounters and generates History and Physical notes, progress notes, discharge summaries, and patient-facing instructions, plus EHR integration via SMART on FHIR to pull demographics, problem lists, medications, laboratory values, vital signs, imaging, and encounter data into the workflow. companies.name: Promptfoo
companies.description: Promptfoo is an open-source CLI and TypeScript/Node.js library for evaluating, red-teaming, and security-testing LLM applications, agents, and RAG pipelines. It runs deterministic prompt evals with model-graded and rule-based assertions, generates dynamic adversarial attack probes across 50+ vulnerability categories (prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG poisoning, PII leakage, harmful content, business rule violations), and integrates with CI/CD via a GitHub Action and a `code-scans` command for pull-request review. Promptfoo supports dozens of LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, DeepSeek, Together, Fireworks, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Vercel and Cloudflare AI gateways — plus local runtimes (Ollama, LocalAI, llama.cpp, vLLM, llamafile, Docker Model Runner) and custom HTTP/WebSocket/Python/JavaScript/Go/Ruby/Shell providers. It also ships an MCP server (`promptfoo mcp`), a Model Audit scanner (`scan-model`) for malicious ML artifacts, and a hosted Enterprise tier with team sharing, continuous monitoring, SSO, and a centralized compliance dashboard aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, and the EU AI Act. The project is MIT-licensed, has 21k+ GitHub stars, and is now part of OpenAI while remaining open source.

Wenrix operates from offices in Tel Aviv, New York, and Barcelona.

The platform orchestrates SMS, voice, email, and chat across the patient journey — appointment scheduling and reminders, patient intake, payments, referral management, care-gap closure, prescription refills, multilingual engagement, and after-hours call routing and triage — increasingly through agentic AI. Zendesk acquired Ultimate.ai in 2024 and the product now ships as Zendesk AI agents (the "AI agents - Advanced" add-on); ultimate.ai redirects to zendesk.com and the successor AI Agents APIs (Chat, Ticket, Widget Escalation, Data Export, Delete User Data plus webhooks) are documented on developer.zendesk.com, with API keys still generated from the Ultimate.ai dashboard. The legacy Ultimate.ai Public API on chat.ultimate.ai is retired.

companies.name: 6Sense Insights
companies.description: 6Sense Insights, Inc. (6sense) is a San Francisco-based revenue AI platform for B2B account-based marketing and sales. Using its Signalverse intent graph and 6AI predictive models, 6sense identifies in-market accounts, deanonymizes anonymous web traffic, scores leads and accounts, and enriches company and contact data across the buying journey. Backed by Battery Ventures, the company publishes a public API portal at api.6sense.com spanning Company Identification, Company Firmographics, Lead Scoring, and People Enrichment/Search APIs (token-authenticated). This record is the company / VC-portfolio profile for 6sense; the full, fully-enriched API contract set for the same company is maintained under the primary "6sense" provider in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: API Harmony
companies.description: API Harmony was an API discovery and recommendation tool from IBM Research that used graph-based search, machine learning, and cognitive technologies to help developers find, compare, and select compatible APIs. It was offered as a cloud service on IBM Bluemix and has since been discontinued.

companies.name: APIsec
companies.description: APIsec (listed as "Fxlabs" in Canaan Partners' portfolio directory, which resolves to apisec.ai) is an AI-powered API and application security platform that delivers continuous, automated security testing across the full API lifecycle. Rather than only flagging potential issues, APIsec combines threat modeling, attack-surface mapping, and AI-driven exploit validation to prove which vulnerabilities are actually exploitable at runtime — producing replayable evidence and remediation guidance. Its products span the APIsec Platform (continuous scanning and OWASP API Top 10 coverage), apisec Surface (open-source mapping of APIs, endpoints, and AI connections), and a large practitioner community through APIsec University (150,000+ practitioners) and Discord (15,000+ members). The company also publishes open-source security tooling and Agent Skills that embed OWASP API Security Top 10 intelligence directly into AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot.

companies.name: Assured
companies.description: Assured is an AI platform for end-to-end property and casualty (P&C) insurance claims processing, positioning itself as the most widely deployed AI in P&C and processing tens of millions of claims annually. Its modular, interconnected products span the claims lifecycle: FNOL (First Notice of Loss) digital intake, Voice AI telephonic intake, First Contact document gathering, Service Assignment contractor scheduling, omnichannel Messaging, the Emma agentic claim-analysis assistant, the Sidekick telephonic FNOL assistant for adjusters, Fraud Detection, and CAT catastrophe triage. The platform is model-agnostic (working across multiple frontier AI providers), with claims-specific safety controls, explainability, human-in-the-loop workflows, and enterprise-grade monitoring and guardrails. Assured serves personal and commercial auto, homeowners, commercial property, and workers' compensation lines. It is an enterprise, sales-led product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or self-serve documentation. Backed by Costanoa Ventures, DCM Ventures, ICONIQ Capital, Kindred Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins.

companies.name: AVAP BRUNIX
companies.description: AVAP BRUNIX is an AI-powered API development platform that serves as a copilot for developers, integrating artificial intelligence directly into the core of the AVAP framework to enhance efficiency and productivity in API development, testing, and management.

companies.name: Citrine Informatics
companies.description: Citrine Informatics is an enterprise AI software company for materials and chemicals product development, positioning itself as the world leader in generative AI for the space. The Citrine Platform pairs Citrine DataManager (capturing and organizing organizational materials knowledge on the open-source GEMD data model) with Citrine VirtualLab (running thousands of virtual experiments via Sequential Learning to identify promising formulations), supported by Citrine Catalyst and professional services. Developers integrate through the first-party Python SDK (the "citrine" and "gemd" PyPI libraries) to upload and manage data, build tables, and configure predictors and design spaces. Citrine serves 15+ industries including specialty chemicals, coatings/adhesives/sealants, plastics, personal care, food & beverage, batteries, and metals & alloys, with customers such as LyondellBasell, Eastman, Grace, Stepan, and Collano, plus a DARPA INTACT ceramics program.

companies.name: Cloverleaf AI
companies.description: Cloverleaf AI is a business-to-government (B2G) sales intelligence platform, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, that monitors 45,000+ government organizations across federal, state, local, and education (SLED) agencies and turns 1.5 million public government meetings into pre-RFP buying signals. It analyzes committee meetings, budget discussions, and procurement activity, applies custom speech-to-text and speaker "vocal fingerprinting" (70,000+ verified speakers) to attribute officials' positions, and delivers a prioritized, territory-specific daily brief to each seller, synced to Salesforce, so government contractors reach buyers before the RFP is published. Products include the Opportunity Database and Vocal Fingerprinting. Cloverleaf AI is Techstars-backed and raised seed funding led by Jackson Square Ventures. No public developer API or documentation is currently published; the platform is delivered as a SaaS product with a Salesforce integration and a demo-request sales motion.

companies.name: Datavolo
companies.description: Datavolo is a dataflow infrastructure company building multimodal data pipelines for generative AI and unstructured data, powered by Apache NiFi. Founded by the original creators of Apache NiFi, Datavolo delivers fast, horizontally scalable pipelines that can be instantly reconfigured, with built-in data lineage, for AI/ML and data engineering teams working with documents, images, audio, and other unstructured sources. Datavolo was acquired by Snowflake in November 2024 and its technology continues under the Snowflake data platform. The company operates a hosted cloud service (cloud.datavolo.ai / app.datavolo.ai), a documentation site, a developer DevCenter of tutorials, and open-source tooling for the Apache NiFi ecosystem published under the datavolo-io GitHub organization.

companies.name: Huginn
companies.description: Huginn is an open-source system for building agents that perform automated tasks online. Self-hosted agents can monitor the web, send and receive events, and trigger workflows. Each Huginn instance exposes a JSON-based HTTP interface (the Web Requests API) that lets external systems trigger scenarios and post events into the platform.

companies.name: nference
companies.description: nference is a healthcare-AI company that builds an agentic intelligence layer for clinical research and drug development. Its nSights platform aggregates and analyzes de-identified multimodal patient data at massive scale — 1.4 billion+ clinical notes, 10 billion+ radiology images, 20 million+ digitized pathology whole-slide images, 12 million+ ECG waveforms, and 100 million+ echocardiogram videos — extracting 30,000+ clinical biomarkers to help life-sciences and health-system partners design patient cohorts, explore patient journeys, annotate data for model development, and run advanced data-science workflows across cardiology, oncology, immunology, rare diseases, neurology, infectious diseases, and nephrology. nference spun out the venture companies Anumana (ECG-based biomarker discovery) and Pramana (digital pathology). The company operates as an enterprise B2B platform with no public self-serve API; it is profiled here for its security, compliance, and governance posture. Backed by Matrix Partners.

companies.name: Yampa
companies.description: Yampa is a Paris-based B2B platform for deploying and operating fleets of autonomous AI agents that handle customer service end-to-end across voice, chat, email, ticketing, and messaging channels. Its Y.core orchestration platform provides a visual workflow builder, guardrails, a knowledge layer, multichannel orchestration, QA and auditing tools, and observability, with connectors to CRMs, helpdesks, and telephony systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, Twilio, Genesys, and others). Founded in 2024 by Marin Huet, Baptiste Saintot, and Patrice Mazoyer, Yampa raised a ~EUR 3M seed led by Partech and emphasizes sovereign EU-hosted infrastructure with GDPR and SOC 2 aligned security. Developer documentation at docs.yampa.ai is gated behind an access code; the public status page lists an API component alongside chat, email, calls, and console services.

companies.name: Audigo Labs
companies.description: Audigo Labs is a San Francisco consumer audio company, founded in 2019 by former Tesla engineer and drummer Armen Nazarian, that makes a pocket-sized mobile recording studio: wireless smart microphones paired with the Audigo iOS and Android app for multi-track recording, multi-mic capture, automatic clip correction, editing, remote collaboration, live streaming, and sharing. The company sells its hardware and Studio subscription plans through a Shopify-hosted storefront at audigolabs.com and supports customers through a Zendesk help center. Audigo publishes no first-party developer API; its public agent-facing surface is the Shopify commerce platform — a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a live buy-for-me MCP endpoint, OpenID Connect / OAuth authorization-server discovery for Shopify Customer Accounts, and an /llms.txt agent-shopping guide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company.

companies.name: Character.AI
companies.description: Character.AI is a consumer conversational-AI platform that lets users create and chat with AI personas (Characters) via web and mobile apps. Character.AI does not publish a public developer API; product surfaces are accessed through the consumer apps. Community-maintained reverse-engineered clients exist but are unofficial and unsupported.

companies.name: everlane
companies.description: Everlane is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer apparel and footwear brand known for its "Radical Transparency" model — publishing factory sourcing, true costs, and markups on everyday wardrobe essentials. As an API Evangelist network entry, Everlane has no bespoke public developer program; its online store runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-facing commerce surface: a live Storefront MCP server at everlane.com/api/mcp (product search, cart, product details, and policy/FAQ lookup), a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile at /.well-known/ucp, a published /llms.txt of agent instructions, and Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth2 authentication. Surfaced as a Slow Ventures portfolio company and enriched from its public agent, well-known, and authentication surfaces.

companies.name: General Intelligence
companies.description: The General Intelligence Company of New York builds Cofounder, an AI agent orchestration platform that lets a founder run an entire business through a coordinating network of specialized agents. Cofounder breaks a company into repeatable Flows and deploys agents across engineering, design, marketing, sales, finance, and support - handling product code, brand assets, outbound campaigns, incorporation, and customer service with human-approval checkpoints before significant actions execute. It provisions managed GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase, connects Stripe, Linear, Postmark, and Composio-powered MCP toolkits, and coordinates departments over shared company context. The company raised an $8.7M seed led by Union Square Ventures. Cofounder is a product workspace, not a public developer API - it consumes external APIs and MCP servers rather than publishing its own REST surface.

companies.name: GraphQL Code Generator
companies.description: GraphQL Code Generator is an open source tool from The Guild that generates typed code from GraphQL schemas and operations. It supports TypeScript, React Query, Apollo Client, Urql, and many other plugins for producing type-safe GraphQL clients and server resolvers.

companies.name: imbee
companies.description: imBee is an AI-powered business omnichannel messaging platform headquartered in Hong Kong that unifies customer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WeChat, LINE, and SMS into a single enterprise-grade inbox. The platform layers team assignment, tagging, marketing broadcast, chatbot and workflow automation, 300+ pre-built integrations (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Okta SSO), and generative-AI tools (AiskBee knowledge assistant and an autonomous AI Agent) on top of the official WhatsApp Business Platform APIs. imBee is ISO 27001 certified with message-level data masking, role-based access, and audit logging, and serves 10,000+ enterprises across 60+ industries in Asia-Pacific with particular strength in Financial Services, Healthcare, Hospitality, Logistics, Property Management, and Retail. Founded in 2019, imBee raised US$5M in Series A funding led by DCM Ventures in 2022.

companies.name: Kiota
companies.description: Kiota is an open source API client generator from Microsoft that produces strongly-typed, lightweight clients from OpenAPI descriptions. It supports C#, Go, Java, PHP, Python, Ruby, Swift, and TypeScript, with a focus on minimal dependencies and idiomatic code patterns.

companies.name: OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation
companies.description: The OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation is a Linux Foundation project announced at MWC Barcelona in March 2026. It is an open collaboration hub dedicated to building a foundational reference platform for Radio Access Networks including AI-based algorithms, with founding members AMD, AT&T, Ericsson, Nokia, NVIDIA, and Verizon.

companies.name: Protocol Buffers
companies.description: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral extensible mechanism for serializing structured data, providing a code generation engine that produces efficient data access classes in multiple programming languages.

companies.name: Relyance Ai
companies.description: Relyance AI is an AI-native data security, AI security, and privacy platform that maps data flows from source code through cloud and SaaS systems to AI models. Its core product, Lyo, acts as a "data defense engineer" providing real-time visibility into where sensitive data lives and moves, who accesses it, and how to remediate risk. The platform unifies data security (sensitive-data discovery, classification, and exfiltration detection), AI security (AI agent inventory, MCP server discovery, agentic AI risk), and privacy automation (DSRs, ROPAs, DPIAs, and consent management). Relyance AI is backed by Menlo Ventures.

companies.name: Slingshot Aerospace
companies.description: Slingshot Aerospace is a space operations intelligence and autonomy (SOIA) company that turns sensing, data fusion, and simulation into operational action for satellite operators, defense, and civil space agencies. Its Portal platform and Developer Suite expose orbital intelligence through APIs — the GSN Data API for near-real-time observations, state vectors, and tracking metrics from the Global Sensor Network and Sovereign Space Object Tracking (SSOT); the Seradata API for global satellite and launch intelligence, mission metadata, reliability history, and operator context; and a forthcoming MCP Insights Server exposing analytics, fusion results, and AI-derived insights from the Agatha AI and TALOS AI pipelines. API access is managed through the Portal with API-key credentials and RBAC, and usage is metered in Slingshot Processing Units (SPUs).

companies.name: Attentive.ai
companies.description: Attentive.ai builds AI-powered software for the construction and outdoor services industries, automating property measurements, takeoffs, and estimating from aerial imagery and blueprints. Its Automeasure platform measures properties from satellite and site-plan imagery for landscaping, paving, and snow-removal contractors, while Beam AI (ibeam.ai) automates construction takeoffs and estimates and BIM CoPilot handles modeling, clash detection, and as-built documentation. The company is backed by Insight Partners. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Attentive.ai does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition, so this record captures its identity, security posture, and site link properties rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Aware Health
companies.description: Aware Health is an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) care platform that helps employers, health plans, and brokers reduce MSK spend while preventing orthopedic surgeries and chronic pain. The company pairs licensed clinicians (physical therapists and health coaches) with an AI "Predict" engine to triage, navigate, and manage musculoskeletal conditions virtually, and reports reducing MSK costs by roughly 30%. Its platform spans MSK care, chronic care, surgery decision support, member navigation, analytics, and an employer dashboard, delivered via web and an iOS app. Aware Health is a Techstars portfolio company and has raised seed funding (including a $3M round led by Boomerang VC with Bright Ventures). This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Aware Health does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: beautiful.ai
companies.description: Beautiful.ai is an AI-powered presentation software platform that helps individuals and teams create professional, on-brand presentations quickly. Its "Smart Slides" engine auto-aligns layouts across 300+ customizable templates, adjusting spacing, alignment, and hierarchy automatically, while a "Create with AI" workflow turns prompts, outlines, or documents into polished decks. The platform adds theme and brand controls (locked colors, fonts, logos, footers), data-linked charts and visualizations, slide animations and voice-over narration, viewer analytics, and secure sharing. It integrates with Slack, PowerPoint (add-in), Webex, and a custom ChatGPT GPT. Beautiful.ai is backed by General Catalyst and Trinity Ventures and serves freelancers, consultants, agencies, SMBs, and enterprises for sales, marketing, pitch, reporting, and training use cases. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity, security/compliance posture, and domain security.

companies.name: Chrome River (Emburse)
companies.description: Chrome River is an enterprise travel and expense (T&E) management platform now part of Emburse, offering expense reporting, invoice management, corporate card reconciliation, and travel spend controls for large and global organizations. The chromeriver.com brand now redirects to Emburse Enterprise; expense, invoice, and analytics data are exchanged through Emburse's gated API host (api.emburse.com) and app.chromeriver.com sign-in. Emburse publishes a broad compliance posture (SOC 1/2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001/27701/42001, PCI DSS, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TX-RAMP) via its trust center and operates a public responsible-disclosure program and Atlassian-hosted status page. This profile was surfaced as a Bain Capital Ventures portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Emburse's public surface; no open developer portal or OpenAPI is published, so spec-bearing artifacts are intentionally absent.

companies.name: Cleerly
companies.description: Cleerly is a digital healthcare company building an AI-powered platform for the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease (heart disease). Its software analyzes coronary CT angiography (CCTA) imaging to automatically quantify and characterize atherosclerotic plaque, measure stenosis severity, and stage disease, giving physicians a precise, personalized picture of a patient's heart-disease risk. The goal is to move heart-disease care from symptom-based testing toward direct measurement of plaque, reducing unnecessary invasive procedures while improving diagnostic accuracy. Cleerly operates as an enterprise clinical SaaS delivered to health systems, cardiologists, and imaging centers rather than a public developer API program; it publishes a marketing and clinical-evidence site plus a clinician-facing application (Cleerly Labs) and a public trust center. Cleerly is backed by Battery Ventures and Insight Partners.

companies.name: Elyra
companies.description: Elyra is an AI-powered restaurant operations and reservation platform, backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026 batch) and founded in Stockholm by Felix Odeberg Glasenapp and Alan Mando. The product combines an AI voice agent that answers reservation phone calls, an email concierge that handles confirmations and follow-ups, guest intelligence that builds diner profiles from preferences and booking history, smart table-allocation and walk-in optimization, plus analytics and campaign outreach tooling. It serves restaurant groups primarily across Scandinavia, addressing the roughly 40% of incoming calls restaurants miss and the booking delays that follow. Elyra operates as a business-facing SaaS application at app.elyrasystems.com and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

companies.description: Entropik is a human-insights company whose Decode platform uses Emotion AI — facial coding, eye and gaze tracking, and voice-tonality analysis — to help enterprises understand consumer and user behavior at scale. Decode combines an AI Moderator for automated, human-like qualitative interviews, consumer and shopper insights, webcam-based UX and user research, AI creative attention and emotion prediction, and a centralized Insights Hub research repository with a research copilot. Entropik reports serving 150+ enterprise clients across CPG, technology and software, healthcare and pharma, financial services, and retail and e-commerce. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Entropik does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, product surface, trust and compliance posture, and domain security.

companies.name: Neo.Tax
companies.description: Neo.Tax is an AI-powered tax automation platform that helps enterprises and their accounting teams generate audit-ready R&D tax credit studies, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), and R&D capitalization (IRC Section 174) documentation. The platform ingests engineering and financial data from tools like Jira, GitHub, payroll systems, and Workday and uses large language models and agentic AI to qualify projects under IRC Section 41, eliminating the manual surveys and interviews that traditionally drive R&D tax credit work. Neo.Tax is backed by GV and Uncork Capital and delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS product; it operates a customer application, a help center, a public status page, and a trust center (SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, GDPR) but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: Numina
companies.description: Numina is a New York City-based urban street-intelligence company (founded 2014, backed by 500 Global and SOSV) whose privacy-first, edge-processing computer-vision sensors measure how people, bicycles, and vehicles move through the public right-of-way. Its "Know Your Streets" platform turns anonymous, aggregated activity into multimodal mobility data for urban planners, municipal departments of transportation, and facilities managers, and exposes that data through the Numina Graph GraphQL API and a developer sandbox. (This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio stub under the placeholder label "CTY"; its Website pointer and 500 Global backing identify it as Numina / numina.co.)

companies.name: Pepper
companies.description: Pepper is an AI-first operating platform for independent food and beverage distributors, helping them compete with larger enterprises through automation and digital tooling. Its product suite spans a B2C-style Storefront for operator ordering, an AI Order Agent that captures orders across voice, text, image, and handwriting, a Sales Hub for reps, a Marketing Hub for direct-to-operator advertising, and a Finance Hub for payments and collections. Pepper integrates with 70+ ERP systems and serves broadline, produce, seafood, meat, JanSan, convenience, coffee, alcohol, and ice cream distribution. The company is backed by Greylock, ICONIQ Capital, and Index Ventures. Pepper does not currently publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures its public company and security surface.
