companies.description: Insurify is an insurance comparison marketplace licensed in all 50 U.S. states with real-time API integrations into 120+ carriers (500+ across the carrier network), covering auto, home, renters, pet, commercial auto, life, motorcycle, and travel. Consumers get side-by-side quotes in roughly two minutes and can buy online or through licensed agents. Insurify's Evia AI agent (Expert Virtual Insurance Agent) is a voice-and-chat agent that handles end-to-end shopping conversations with bind-ready quotes and renewal-cycle re-shopping. In February 2026 Insurify launched the insurance industry's first ChatGPT app via OpenAI's app library.

companies.name: JOLYN
companies.description: JOLYN is an athletic swimwear and apparel brand for competitive and team swimming, water polo, and aquatics, known for durable, functional practice and racing suits, team uniforms, and active lifestyle apparel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, JOLYN publishes no first-party developer API — its direct-to-consumer storefront at jolyn.com (jolynclothing.com redirects here) is Shopify-hosted. That platform exposes a genuine agent-native commerce surface: a published /llms.txt with agent instructions, OpenID Connect discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for buyer-approved, agent-driven shopping and checkout.

companies.name: Rouje
companies.description: Rouje is a Parisian ready-to-wear and beauty brand founded by Jeanne Damas, selling feminine ready-to-wear, shoes, accessories, and the "Les Filles en Rouje" makeup and skincare line direct-to-consumer online and through boutiques across France. Rouje has no first-party developer API, but its Shopify-hosted storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven shopping and checkout, a published llms.txt / agents.md with explicit agent instructions, Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect discovery, and public read-only product/collection JSON endpoints. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

companies.name: Susquehanna International Group (SIG)
companies.description: Susquehanna International Group (SIG) is a privately held global quantitative trading firm founded in 1987 by a group of college friends who began trading on the Philadelphia Stock Exchange, leveraging quantitative skills and poker-derived decision science. Headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, the firm employs more than 3,500 people across 17+ offices worldwide and operates as one of the largest options market makers globally. SIG's businesses span Quantitative Trading, Predictions, Institutional Sales, Growth Equity (Susquehanna Growth Equity / SGE), Sustainable Investments, Asia-focused Venture Capital (notably an early and large stake in ByteDance), and the River's Edge promotional arm. SIG does not operate a public developer portal, expose external trading APIs, or publish open-source repositories under a public GitHub organization; all technology is internal to the trading and quantitative research platform. Public surface is limited to sig.com (company / careers / insights), the SGE site, and corporate communications.

companies.name: Taizen
companies.description: Taizen is a managed agentic AI platform for go-to-market teams that automates win/loss analysis and competitive intelligence. Its Signals agent continuously monitors recorded sales calls (via Gong, Fireflies, tl;dv, and Granola), CRM closed-lost deal data, competitor pricing pages and product changelogs, press releases, and G2 reviews to detect recurring objections and material competitor moves, then auto-generates battlecards, rep-training drills, and AI-roleplay scenarios. Taizen also books and runs AI-led interviews with lost buyers and pushes real-time competitive updates to teams via Slack, with delivery through a Monday-morning weekly digest and instant alerts. Backed by Techstars, the company emphasizes built-in governance and no model-vendor lock-in, and open sources supporting retrieval and GTM tooling on GitHub. This is a customer-facing SaaS product with no public API surface at the time of enrichment.

companies.name: Talus Network
companies.description: Talus Network is a decentralized Layer 1 platform for building and running autonomous, verifiable AI agents fully on-chain. Its core product, Nexus, is an agentic workflow engine that lets developers compose agents as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of reusable Tools — LLM calls, HTTP requests, storage, exchanges — executed and settled on-chain. Talus is built on Sui Move smart contracts with a Cosmos SDK / CometBFT Protochain node, and ships a developer surface as Rust crates (nexus-sdk, nexus-cli, nexus-toolkit), a Homebrew/AUR CLI, GitBook developer docs, and on-chain Move module API references. Backed by Polychain, Talus positions itself as infrastructure for the autonomous digital economy. There is no traditional REST / OpenAPI HTTP API; the platform is consumed through the SDK, CLI, and Move contracts.

companies.name: Teabox
companies.description: Teabox is a premium loose-leaf tea brand and direct-to-consumer e-commerce company backed by Accel. It sources fresh Darjeeling, Assam, Nilgiri and other Indian teas direct from gardens and ships them globally through its online store. The storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes an agent-commerce surface built on the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP): a hosted shopping MCP endpoint, a machine-readable llms.txt / agents.md, and OpenID Connect authentication via the Shopify Customer Account API (including a customer-account MCP scope). Buyer checkout always requires explicit human approval. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched from Teabox's public agent-facing surfaces.

companies.name: Trezy
companies.description: Trezy is a Franco-Dutch fintech SaaS (Trezy SAS, founded 2021 in Paris by Quentin Lacointa) offering AI-driven cash flow management for small and medium businesses across Europe, the US, and Canada. It connects to 2,000+ banks via PSD2/Open Banking to deliver real-time cash position, automatic AI transaction categorization, 95%-accurate 12-month cash flow forecasting, real-time P&L, 27+ financial KPIs, supplier cost analysis, and OCR-based document management from a single platform starting at a free tier. Trezy also offers dedicated plans for external CFOs (DAF) and accounting firms, and integrates with QuickBooks Online and Pennylane. Backed by Seedcamp and Playfair Capital (with Kima Ventures and Discovery Ventures) in a €3M seed round. Trezy publishes an llms.txt corpus and an /.well-known/ai-plugin.json manifest but does not expose a public developer API.

companies.name: True & Co
companies.description: True & Co is a direct-to-consumer women's intimates and lingerie brand, originally venture-backed (Cowboy Ventures, Uncork Capital) and now operating under PVH Corp. It sells bras, underwear, and loungewear online through a Shopify-hosted storefront at trueandco.com. The store exposes no traditional developer API, but it does expose a modern agent-commerce surface: a hosted Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for catalog, cart, and checkout, Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OIDC for buyer identity, a public read-only storefront JSON surface, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md.

companies.name: wanelo
companies.description: wanelo ("The intelligent everything store") is an AI-powered shopping storefront offering natural-language and visual product discovery, personalized recommendations, and a buy-for-me assistant, built on Shopify. It exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, ucp.dev) with a hosted MCP endpoint for catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OpenID Connect and a published /llms.txt (mirroring /agents.md). Originally a social-shopping product backed by Slow Ventures, wanelo.com now operates as an agent-ready commerce store. Read-only catalog browsing (products/collections/search JSON) requires no authentication.

companies.name: Alif Semiconductor
companies.description: Alif Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Pleasanton, California with engineering operations in Grenoble, France. It designs secure, AI/ML-enabled 32-bit microcontrollers and fusion processors for edge computing, built around Arm Cortex-M55 cores and dedicated Arm Ethos-U55 Neural Processing Units. Its Ensemble (E1C, E1, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8) and Balletto (B1) product families target battery-powered edge AI and generative-AI workloads, pairing hardware AI acceleration with autonomous aiPM power management and a multilayered hardware Root of Trust security subsystem. Alif ships an embedded developer surface rather than a public web API: a Zephyr-based SDK, CMSIS Device Family Packs, VS Code project templates, the Conductor configuration tool, evaluation kits, datasheets, and reference manuals published across its support hub and GitHub organization. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and Mayfield.

companies.name: Chui
companies.description: Chui, now operating as Trueface (part of BigBear.ai after the Pangiam acquisition), is a facial recognition and computer vision company. Originally launched as "Chui," the world's first faceprint API for access and identity, the technology is delivered today as a licensed developer SDK with C++, Python, Android, and iOS bindings, plus a Dockerized on-premises REST API (Trueface On-Prem / PTOP) for 1:1 and 1:N face matching, spoof and liveness detection, object detection, and identity verification. Deployment options span on-device, self-hosted Docker, and AWS. The technology has been evaluated in NIST FRVT and DHS/CBP testing and is applied across fintech, education, security, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and government. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: GoSky AI
companies.description: GoSky AI Inc. is a Taipei-based no-code conversational marketing and social CRM platform that helps creators, brands, and enterprises automate customer engagement across Instagram, Threads, and Facebook Messenger. The company operates a hosted SaaS console at platform.goskyai.com and reports serving 400+ enterprises including Mercedes-Benz, VOGUE, and Lazada. GoSky AI is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass GoSky AI publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Kayak
companies.description: KAYAK is a free travel metasearch engine that searches hundreds of travel sites at once so travelers can compare and find the lowest available prices on flights, hotels, rental cars, and vacation packages, with an extensive filtering system for narrowing results. Founded in 2004 and part of Booking Holdings, KAYAK operates a family of global travel brands (including momondo, Cheapflights, HotelsCombined, SWOODOO, checkfelix and Mundi) across 60+ international sites in 25+ languages. Beyond consumer metasearch it offers KAYAK for Business, a Flight Tracker, an Explore destination-discovery tool, and KAYAK AI trip-planning. KAYAK is a metasearch and price-comparison engine rather than an online travel agency — bookings are completed with the airline, hotel, car-rental company, or travel agency. This profile documents KAYAK's public discovery, AI, and security surface; KAYAK does not currently operate a public self-serve developer API program.

companies.description: 'MAI is an AI performance-marketing platform that runs autonomous AI agents to create, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns 24/7 on behalf of brands. As of 2026 it reports 2.89M+ registered drivers and coverage across 33 countries. It integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace via API in about five minutes with no MX record changes, can run in monitoring mode, provides explainable incident response with Indicators of Compromise for CISOs, and reduces false positives by up to 90%. Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

The platform is used by general contractors, subcontractors, and specialty trades to track risk, align teams on standards, and act on contractual exposure. companies.name: Verisian
companies.description: Verisian is an AI infrastructure platform for clinical trials, giving pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs the information infrastructure required to deploy AI across their experts and processes. The platform provides full study traceability and automates statistical programming workflows: automating the validation of SDTM and ADaM analysis datasets (turning time-consuming QC double-programming into value-generating QA oversight), and generating complete define-XML files and draft reviewer's guides that are guaranteed consistent with the underlying analysis, so teams are submission-ready in hours. The platform emphasizes transparent, explainable AI ("AI that shows its work") with natural-language interaction, automated email digests, and 300+ integrations into ERPs, billing, procure-to-pay, and HRIS systems. companies.description: Zinier is a no-code field service management platform that helps enterprises schedule and manage their workforce, assets, and customers, powered by generative AI. Its office and field experiences pair ready-to-use productivity tools with a no-code Task Builder for building custom workflows, and an Integration Marketplace advertising 1,000+ out-of-the-box connections to ERP, CRM, and EAM systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, IBM, and Infor. Zinier targets asset-intensive field-service operations, from scheduling and dispatch through mobile task execution and customer communication. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and ICONIQ Capital. No public developer API, API reference, or OpenAPI surface is published today — integration is delivered through the marketplace and end-user product documentation.

companies.name: Chaoslabs
companies.description: Chaos Labs is a New York-based company building financial-intelligence and economic-security infrastructure for onchain markets. Its flagship product, Edge (Chaos Oracles), is a decentralized oracle protocol that unifies real-time price, risk, and proof-of-reserves data, delivering high-precision price feeds with an integrated risk engine plus automated, real-time risk-parameter optimization. Leading DeFi protocols including Aave, GMX, dYdX, Jupiter, Venus, Lido, Maker and Uniswap Foundation use Chaos Labs to help secure billions of dollars in value. Developer integration spans EVM, SVM, off-chain services and TradingView via docs.chaoslabs.xyz. Founded in 2021 by Omer Goldberg and Julian Lindinger, Chaos Labs is backed by Haun Ventures, Galaxy, PayPal Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Lightspeed, Bessemer and others, and holds ISO/IEC 27001 certification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched from Chaos Labs' real public developer surface.

companies.name: Deduce
companies.description: Deduce is a New York City-based identity intelligence and fraud-prevention company focused on detecting stolen and synthetic identities, including the rapidly growing class of AI-generated identities used to bypass traditional Know Your Customer and onboarding controls. The company operates the Deduce Identity Graph, an activity-backed U.S. identity network the firm describes as covering 185 million weekly active users and 1.5 billion daily events, used to deliver real-time multi-contextual risk and fraud signals during new account opening, login, and checkout. Deduce sells a real-time API-based fraud-risk scoring product, a Multicontextual Identity Insights service, and a browser-based dashboard for traffic segmentation, anomaly detection, and forensic review, with pre-built integrations into common identity platforms (Auth0, Microsoft Entra External ID / Azure AD B2C, ForgeRock / Ping, Gluu) alongside a native REST API. The company sells to banks, fintechs, lenders, BNPL providers, retail, travel, and payments platforms; its commercial model is enterprise contracts, and its developer documentation, OpenAPI definitions, and integration guides sit behind an authenticated portal, with no public GitHub repositories, no public SDKs, and no published machine-readable API specification.

Sonus Health ships as iOS and Android apps for pet owners and a web dashboard for veterinary clinics.

Geniebook serves more than 220,000 students across Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. It is a consumer (B2C) learning application delivered via web and mobile apps; no public developer API is published.

The platform targets general contractors and BIM teams for automated site supervision, progress reporting, and issue detection, and promotes 100% open data with direct integrations into tools such as Autodesk Construction Cloud. Imerso is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record.

Pascal sits inside Excel, PowerPoint, Word, email, and the browser through an Agent Control Center, ships 25+ pre-built research agents, maintains a persistent knowledge graph and memory across every document a team has touched, and returns fully cited outputs with RBAC enforcement. Founded in 2019 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile, Pietra does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

Its products include PointOne Time (automatic cross-device time capture with AI-generated narratives), PointOne Review (pre-bill review with AI markup and collaboration), and PointOne Intelligence (time analytics and resource-allocation insights), along with automatic enforcement of Outside Counsel Guidelines. companies.description: Pomo is an AI marketing platform that runs an always-on AI marketing team, turning continuous market, competitor, brand, and trend intelligence into strategy, creative direction, ad-placement planning, and launch-ready campaign workflows for lean growth, brand, and performance teams. It monitors signals daily, surfaces opportunity and whitespace, drafts approval-ready campaigns, briefs, and creatives, and supports AEO/GEO AI-search visibility and Marketing Mix Modeling. Pomo is also offered as a managed service where in-house marketing experts operate the platform on a customer's behalf. Founded in 2025 and based in Palo Alto, California, Pomo raised a $4.5M seed round led by Kindred Ventures with Databricks Ventures, SV Angel, and angel investors. There is no public developer API; the site publishes a real /llms.txt AI-discovery document but no OpenAPI, docs, or developer surface.

The platform automates detection and classification of sensitive data across hybrid and multi-cloud environments and prevents regulated data from leaking into AI tools, assistants, and inference pipelines. Secuvy offers more than 250 connectors covering AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, MongoDB, and on-premise systems like Windows File Servers, SharePoint, and NFS. Authentication options include OAuth, SAML, and API key based integration, and developers can build custom connectors against any system with a public API. Public API reference documentation was not located during research; technical detail is provided through Secuvy's sales and onboarding teams.

Hivemind itself is delivered as a layered platform: EdgeOS (real-time C++ autonomy middleware), Pilot (autonomy behavior catalog), Forge (autonomy factory for build, sim, and test), and Commander (C2 and fleet integration). In 2025 Shield AI introduced Hivemind Enterprise, a partner-facing SDK for building, evaluating, testing, and deploying mission autonomy on customer platforms. There is no public, self-service API; access to Hivemind SDKs and developer tooling is gated through partnership and is subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR).

Solvely is available on the web, iOS, Android, and as a Chrome/Edge browser extension, with free and paid (Solvely Unlimited) tiers. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

Securiti was founded in 2018 by Rehan Jalil and has been recognized as a Gartner Customers' Choice and an IDC Worldwide Leader in data privacy and data security. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscription with usage-based connector and module pricing; no public free tier or self-serve API key issuance is currently offered.

companies.description: Duco is an AI-powered operational data automation platform for financial services. The no-code platform ingests data from any source (including unstructured documents via Adaptive Intelligent Document Processing), then transforms, matches, reconciles and publishes it with full audit and control. Duco's Agentic Workspace layers agentic AI over these operations so agents can handle repetitive extraction, matching and exception-labelling work under human oversight. Use cases span securities and derivatives reconciliation, ETD clearing, OTC confirmations, custody, cash accounts, crypto holdings and transaction/regulatory reporting (EMIR, CFTC, MiFID II, ASIC, MAS, T+1). companies.description: GovGuard is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) GovTech company building AI infrastructure for government agencies, starting with Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request automation. Its AI agents route incoming public-records requests, search across municipal archives (emails, meeting minutes, PDFs, and shared drives), flag personally identifiable information and other exempt material for redaction against the relevant state exemption codes, and draft response letters for clerk review while maintaining a complete audit trail. Agencies retain full ownership and control of all records and metadata, and GovGuard states that it does not train models on client data. The company was founded by Aditya Sabharwal and Gleb Hulting and is based in San Francisco.

companies.name: InventoryQuant
companies.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

The platform also ingests an employer's health plan and benefits so it can notify members when an existing benefit could help. Milu is offered through employers and benefits advisors as well as directly to individuals. The company raised a $4.8M seed round led by a16z Bio + Health in March 2024. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; Milu does not currently publish a public developer API.

It targets investment banking, consulting, private equity and credit, and asset and wealth management. Model ML is a fintech company backed by QED Investors. The company publishes a trust center and a security program (ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR) but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

companies.description: Murphy is a Barcelona-based fintech building AI voice and omnichannel agents that automate debt collection and servicing for banks, fintechs, utilities, telecoms and debt collection agencies. Founded in 2024 by Borja Sole and Marc Sanchez, the platform runs 24/7 AI agents across voice, SMS and email in 15+ languages, handling inbound and outbound recovery with human escalation, behavioural personalisation and fully audited, compliance-bounded interactions (ISO 27001, GDPR and EU AI Act aligned). Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface is currently published.

companies.name: Naboo

Any AI agent in the organization queries the graph in GraphQL, or through an MCP server that turns plain intent into a structured query, and gets a structured answer instead of a list of search results. Naboo deploys on-premise or in a customer VPC with zero data egress, integrates with any LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and agentic framework (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), and enforces existing role-based access controls at retrieval time. Founded in 2023 by Gilad Salinger (CEO) and Dror Wolmer (CTO), with production customers Global-E (NASDAQ: GLBE) and Melio.

companies.name: Palm
companies.description: Palm is an AI cash flow forecasting platform for corporate treasury and finance teams. It sits above existing Treasury Management Systems (TMS) and ERPs, unifying visibility across cash positions and forecasting liquidity directly from bank and transaction data. Palm learns the timing and size of recurring cash flows from historical transactions to keep a rolling 13-week-and-longer forecast current automatically, and combines ERP data, bank transactions, and 25+ AI models to improve forecast accuracy by over 60%. The product spans AI cash forecasting, what-if scenario modeling, continuous forecast-vs-actual variance analysis, automated daily cash positioning across banks and currencies, surplus-cash investment identification, board-ready treasury reporting, and a "Pulse" anomaly-detection assistant. Palm is a speedinvest portfolio company. It integrates with TMS (Coupa, FIS, ION, Kyriba), banks (Citi, HSBC, J.P. Morgan), investment platforms, data warehouses, and ERPs (SAP, IFS), but does not publish a public developer API.

Quantcast also operates Quantcast Measure, a free audience measurement product that has tagged millions of digital properties to produce demographic, psychographic, and cross-device audience insights. For programmatic access, Quantcast exposes a developer portal at developers.quantcast.com built around a GraphQL API (v2) for reporting, campaign management, and audience operations on the Quantcast Platform, secured via OAuth 2.0 client credentials. A server-to-server Conversion API augments the browser-side Live Tag for offline and signal-loss-resilient conversion tracking. Quantcast Choice, the company's IAB TCF v2-compliant Consent Management Platform, was acquired by InMobi in August 2023 and is now operated as part of InMobi CMP; legacy Quantcast Choice mobile SDKs remain published under the quantcast GitHub organization for reference. Quantcast also open-sources the Quantcast File System (QFS), a C++ distributed file system, and mobile/Roku measurement SDKs.

It is backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

companies.name: Brokk
companies.description: Brokk (Brokk, Inc.) builds AI tooling for large codebases. Rather than a hosted REST API, Brokk ships open-source developer tools centered on "bifrost" — a Tree-sitter-backed multi-language static-analysis engine that gives coding agents structured code intelligence (symbols, definitions, references, call graphs, usage analysis) across 12 languages. Bifrost runs as a CLI, a workspace-aware language server (LSP), and a stdio MCP server, and is published to crates.io (brokk-bifrost) and PyPI (brokk-bifrost-searchtools). The company, founded by Jonathan Ellis (Apache Cassandra / DataStax) and backed by Mayfield, also ships the core Brokk application, the brokk-cli launcher, and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) tooling (anvil, mjolnir).

companies.name: d-Matrix
companies.description: d-Matrix builds ultra-low-latency, energy-efficient AI inference infrastructure for generative AI in the datacenter. Its memory-centric compute architecture, next-generation I/O, and stacked-DRAM approach are delivered through the Corsair inference accelerator (chiplet-based, supporting models up to 100B parameters), the JetStream accelerator-to-accelerator communications platform, the SquadRack disaggregated rack-scale solution, and the 3DIMC 3D digital in-memory compute technology. Founded by Sid Sheth and Sudeep Bhoja and headquartered in Santa Clara, the company has raised roughly $450M (including a $275M Series C) from investors such as Qatar Investment Authority, Temasek, and SK Hynix. d-Matrix also maintains the open-source dmx-compressor (DMX) PyTorch toolkit for co-designing models to its inference hardware. This API Evangelist network profile tracks d-Matrix as a compute-hardware provider; it does not currently publish a public web API.

companies.name: DriveNets
companies.description: DriveNets is a networking software company that applies the disaggregated cloud model to telco-grade and AI networking. Its DriveNets Network Cloud runs DNOS, a cloud-native distributed network operating system, across shared white-box hardware to serve core, aggregation, access, peering, DCI, and AI-fabric use cases. The Network Cloud AI fabric delivers Ethernet-based GPU-cluster interconnect positioned as an alternative to InfiniBand. Founded in 2015, DriveNets powers disaggregated backbones for operators including AT&T, Comcast, Orange, and KDDI. Device management is exposed programmatically via NETCONF/gNMI over OpenConfig and DriveNets YANG models, with a first-party drivenets.dnos Ansible collection for automation; there is no public REST API.

companies.name: MoonLake AI
companies.description: Moonlake AI Inc. is a San Francisco based company building world models and simulation infrastructure for embodied AI. Its platform turns an image, video, or text description into physically accurate, simulation-ready 3D models of the world — assets shipped with baked-in physics and articulation (joints, ranges, drive limits) that export directly to USD, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and MuJoCo. Teams generate sim environments and digital twins in hours instead of weeks via a hosted generation API. Moonlake is backed by Threshold (formerly DFJ), AIX Ventures, and NVIDIA's venture arm, and was named to the CB Insights AI 100 in 2026.

companies.name: Peopleix
companies.description: peopleIX is a People Intelligence platform for HR leaders, built and operated by peopleIX GmbH in Cologne, Germany (founded 2022). It integrates 100+ HR systems (HRIS, ATS, LMS, payroll) and pairs an AI Data Analyst (people analytics — the "what") with AI-led conversations across the workforce (conversation intelligence — the "why") to answer hard workforce questions in hours rather than months. Each engagement leaves a persistent, queryable knowledge layer the customer keeps, which is accessible from Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot via MCP. The service is EU-resident end-to-end, GDPR and ISO 27001 compliant, and never trains on customer data. Backed by Earlybird, neoteq ventures, ts ventures, and business angels. peopleIX does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK — this profile captures the identity, compliance posture, and machine-readable (llms.txt) surface it does publish.

companies.name: Serve First
companies.description: Serve First is a UK-based AI-driven customer experience (CX) platform that unifies reviews, surveys, receipts, in-location feedback terminals, operational audits, and mystery shopping into a single dashboard. It turns real-time customer feedback into role-based, actionable insight, with sentiment analysis and unified reporting across retail, hospitality, facilities management, health & wellness, and franchise businesses. Serve First also provides Client Connect journey/workflow automation and Martyn's Law public-protection compliance management. Serve First does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures company identity plus verified security and compliance posture (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 via a Sprinto-hosted trust center).

companies.name: Sully AI
companies.description: Sully AI is a US-based healthcare AI company that ships a portfolio of "AI employees" for clinical and administrative work — including an AI Scribe that turns patient conversations into structured, HIPAA-compliant notes, an AI Receptionist for scheduling and front desk, an AI Triage Nurse for patient engagement, an AI Medical Coder for autonomous ICD-10 coding, an AI Pharmacist, and an AI Consultant for chart prep. The platform integrates with Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, Athenahealth, Allscripts, Veradigm, and 50+ other EHRs. Beyond the end-user products, Sully exposes a public REST API covering audio transcription (file upload and real-time WebSocket streaming), clinical note generation (SOAP and custom templates), medical coding extraction (ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED), note templates, and a medical consensus alpha feature, with asynchronous results delivered over webhooks. Official Apache-2.0 licensed TypeScript/Node and Python SDKs are published under the sullyai GitHub org, and an Odiggo-maintained sully-api-demo repo showcases end-to-end usage. Sully's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions to healthcare providers, hospitals, and digital health platforms.

companies.name: AlphaAI
companies.description: A REST API and agent-native platform for relevance-scored, ticker-linked financial news, built for trading bots, agent backends, and dashboards. Articles are enriched at ingest with relevance scores, categories, and per-ticker sentiment, plus structured SEC Form 4 insider data.

companies.name: Collibra
companies.description: Collibra is a data intelligence company providing a cloud-based platform for data governance, cataloging, quality, lineage, and AI governance. The Collibra Data Intelligence Platform helps enterprises discover, understand, govern, and trust their data assets through automated lineage tracking, policy management, data observability, and collaborative stewardship. The Collibra developer ecosystem includes REST APIs, GraphQL Knowledge Graph API, workflow automation, and a broad library of source connectors.

companies.name: Flowscope
companies.description: Flowscope is an AI-native process-automation firm (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that deploys agents to observe how a business actually runs, map and redesign its workflows, then ship the automation into production on top of existing systems in days rather than months. It positions itself as the AI team for mid-market operating businesses that do not have one, selling services-as-software with outcome-aligned pricing rather than a self-serve developer API. Founded in 2025 in San Francisco by Samuel Mirpuri (ex-McKinsey QuantumBlack) and Javier Leguina (founding engineer, ModelML), Flowscope runs forward-deployed agents that shadow employees, baseline the process, redesign the work, and write back into legacy systems of record while a human core keeps judgment and accountability in the loop.

companies.name: Getbasis
companies.description: Basis (getbasis.ai) is an AI-powered accounting platform that builds autonomous agents purpose-built for accountants. Its agents execute accounting workflows end-to-end across tax, audit, advisory, and client accounting services (CAS), shifting accounting professionals from doing the work to reviewing it. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security and compliance for accounting firms — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 certifications, AES-256 encryption, strict tenant isolation, and US-only hosting. Basis is backed by Khosla Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It is a product company with no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time.

companies.name: Globant
companies.description: Globant is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Globant API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: Lyric
companies.description: Lyric is an AI-powered supply chain software company, founded in 2022 and backed by Insight Partners. Its Lyric Studio platform lets enterprises model, plan, and optimize their supply chains across four composable layers — Data (enterprise-grade data management and integrations), Algorithms (advanced supply chain science), Workflows (flexible, composable processes), and Models & Apps (ready-to-use applications). The platform spans network modeling, transportation optimization, inventory management, forecasting, routing, and scheduling. Lyric does not publish a public developer API surface; its product documentation at docs.lyric.tech is gated behind a Lyric Studio login. It does operate a public SafeBase security and trust portal documenting SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and CSA STAR Level 1 posture plus a responsible disclosure program.

companies.name: Nauto
companies.description: Nauto is a predictive AI platform for commercial fleet safety. Using in-vehicle AI dash cams and computer vision, it monitors driver behavior in real time, delivers predictive collision alerts before incidents occur, scores driver risk with its VERA system, and powers driver coaching, exoneration, and incident intelligence. Nauto also supports DVIR, IFTA, and ELD fleet-compliance workflows across trucking, delivery, construction, passenger transit, and field-service fleets. Backed by Greylock, Playground Global, and SoftBank Vision Fund, Nauto is SOC 2 Type 1/2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.

companies.name: NewCore
companies.description: NewCore is an enterprise identity-security company building an identity platform that governs both human and AI-agent identities across the enterprise. Its three pillars are Identity Discovery (continuously discovering and mapping every identity across directories, PAM, shadow systems, and AI infrastructure), Identity Security (breach prevention through phishing-resistant authentication and device-bound sessions that cannot be stolen or replayed), and Human + AI Agent Governance (minimum-access provisioning, full lifecycle management, and support for ephemeral agentic workloads). NewCore is backed by Index Ventures. It sells to enterprises via demo request and publishes a trust center (SOC 2 Type II, CSA STAR Level 1, GDPR, CCPA) but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: Ploy
companies.description: Ploy is an AI-powered marketing platform that turns a company's website into its growth engine. Founded in 2025 by former Webflow CTO Bryant Chou and backed by Y Combinator, Ploy deploys AI agents that build and optimize web pages, write copy, run technical SEO fixes, identify and enrich site visitors, launch ad campaigns, and track attribution across three product surfaces (Web, Grow, and Ads). Users activate pre-built marketing strategies called PloyBooks or author custom strategies that agents execute. Ploy is a SaaS product with a credit-based pricing model; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, API reference, SDKs, or developer portal — only a product help center and native integrations (Google, GitHub sync, CRM, and ad platforms).

companies.name: Ragas
companies.description: Ragas is an open-source Python evaluation framework for LLM and RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) applications. It provides metrics, experiments, dataset management, and integrations with LangChain and LlamaIndex. Ragas is delivered as a Python library, not a hosted REST API.

companies.name: Sierra
companies.description: Sierra is a conversational AI platform for customer experience, founded in 2023 by Bret Taylor (former co-CEO of Salesforce, CTO of Facebook, co-creator of Google Maps, and current chair of OpenAI's board) and Clay Bavor (former Google VP who led Labs, Project Starline, Google Lens, and Google Workspace). Headquartered in New York with offices in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, Paris, Madrid, Toronto, Singapore, and Tokyo, Sierra builds branded AI agents that handle customer service, sales, and operational interactions across chat, voice, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and ChatGPT for enterprises including SiriusXM, WeightWatchers, Sonos, ADT, Chime, Sutter Health, Rocket Mortgage, Ramp, Brex, SoFi, Casper, CLEAR, Vivid Seats, Wayfair, AOL, and approximately 40% of the Fortune 50. The platform is anchored by Agent OS 2.0, with Agent Studio (no-code builder for CX teams), Agent SDK (a developer-facing programmatic layer that lets engineering teams write customer journeys as code), Agent Data Platform (persistent cross-session memory unifying structured CRM data and unstructured conversation history), Insights (analytics — Explorer, Monitors, Experiments, Observability), Live Assist (human-in-the-loop), Voice (real-time voice agents), and Ghostwriter (an agent-building agent that generates production-ready multilingual agents from SOPs, transcripts, audio recordings, whiteboard photos, or plain English in 30+ languages). Sierra runs an outcome-based pricing model — customers pay per resolved case, not per seat or per token — and operates a gated developer documentation portal at docs.sierra.ai available only to contracted customers. There is no public REST API, no public Agent SDK package, no public GitHub org, and no self-serve sign-up; access is via enterprise sales. Sierra raised $950M at a $15.8B valuation in May 2026 (after a $350M round at $10B earlier in the year) and reported $150M ARR within roughly two years of public launch. Sierra also acquired the French agent-evaluation startup Fragment in April 2026 and publishes the public τ-bench, τ-voice, and τ-knowledge benchmarks for evaluating agentic systems.

companies.name: Concirrus
companies.description: Concirrus Ltd is a London-headquartered insurtech founded in 2012 that builds AI-driven underwriting software for the specialty and commercial insurance market — marine (hull, cargo, P&I), aviation, construction, property, and political violence and terrorism. Its platform (Quest, Marine One, the Underwriting Workbench, Exposure Management, Loss Run Intelligence, and an "Enterprise Model" universal submission-ingestion layer) ingests broker submissions, structures the risk data, scores behavioural risk, and returns rating and exposure decisions to carriers, MGAs and brokers — much of it aimed at the Lloyd's and London subscription market. Concirrus is a vendor to insurers rather than an insurer itself, so it touches quote and rating rather than bind, issue or FNOL. Its API posture is partner-gated: marketing describes "a modular, API first platform" and "seamless integration with London Market platforms", but as of 2026-07-25 there is no public developer portal, no published API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, no Postman collection, and no public GraphQL or webhook catalog. Every developer and docs hostname probed (developer./developers./docs./api. on both concirrus.com and concirrus.ai) does not resolve, and every on-site developer path returns 404. Integration is obtained through a commercial engagement or the partner ecosystem programme, not self-serve signup. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or ACORD XML reference appears anywhere on the public site. Concirrus does publish a real compliance posture: in August 2025 it announced ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001 (information security) and SOC 2 certification, claiming to be the first insurtech to hold all three — though no trust center or downloadable report accompanies the announcement.

companies.name: Glen
companies.description: Glen is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building a shared organizational learning and memory system for fleets of AI agents. The platform acts as a centralized store that every AI agent in a company can read from and write to, so that when one agent learns something the whole organization gains access to it. Glen preserves decisions, customer insights and operational procedures with full audit trails, applies role-based access control per observation at recall time, and connects to coding agents, PR assistants, bug bots and sales agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It integrates with the tools where work already lives (code repositories, pull requests, issues, documentation and meetings) to give both agents and humans unified organizational context, aiming to eliminate knowledge silos, reduce new-hire ramp time and retain institutional knowledge through employee turnover. The company is pre-launch and operating a waitlist; its primary integration surface is an MCP server rather than a traditional REST API.

Product lines include Resolve Actions, Actions Pro, Actions Express, and Barista, spanning IT process automation (ITPA), robotic process automation, and agentic service management. companies.name: Decagon
companies.description: Decagon is a San Francisco-based AI customer experience company founded in August 2023 by Jesse Zhang and Ashwin Sreenivas, with additional offices in New York City and London. The company builds, optimizes, and scales AI agents that resolve customer support across voice, chat, email, and SMS channels for enterprise brands including Notion, Eventbrite, Duolingo, Chime, ClassPass, Hertz, Rippling, Noom, Oura, Samsara, Dropbox, Mercado Libre, Bilt, Cash App, Square, Fanatics, and Riot Games. Its platform centers on Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) — natural-language workflow definitions executed by AI agents — alongside Watchtower for continuous QA, Experiments for live A/B testing, Insights & Reporting analytics, and Suggestions for AI-powered knowledge management. Decagon connects to customer stacks through pre-built integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, Confluence, Contentful, Kustomer, Amazon Connect, RingCentral, Stripe), Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and custom API endpoints, but the platform's own developer-facing APIs, SDKs, OpenAPI specs, and technical setup documentation are not published publicly and are made available only to contracted enterprise customers and implementation partners. Decagon has raised $481M across rounds led by Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, and Coatue Management, reaching a $4.5B valuation following its January 2026 Series D, and was ranked #38 on the 2026 CNBC Disruptor 50 list.

companies.name: Dreamforge
companies.description: DreamForge.ai is an AI-powered game creation platform for building, iterating on, and publishing 2D and stylized 3D games directly in the browser. The platform pairs a creator-facing web studio (including an Asset Studio) with a consumer application distributed on Steam, iOS, and Android. Founded in 2025 and based in Miami, Florida, DreamForge is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). DreamForge supports stylized 3D world generation, textures, voxels, and billboarding workflows; native 3D model generation is not currently provided. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published at this time.

companies.name: exein
companies.description: Exein is a Physical AI and embedded/IoT cybersecurity company (Italy) that secures connected devices, firmware, and Linux/RTOS embedded systems. Its platform pairs on-device runtime threat detection (Exein Runtime) with AI-powered firmware analysis and SBOM ingestion (Exein Analyzer), mapping findings to standards including the EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI EN 303-645, IEC 62443, RED 3.3, and the US Cyber Trust Mark. Exein does not publish a hosted public REST API; its developer surface is open-source security tooling in the exein-io GitHub organization — notably Pulsar (an eBPF-powered runtime security agent) and Kepler (a NIST-based CVE lookup store and API). Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital, hv-capital, and partech.

A user describes a business idea and MadeThis autonomously handles website and app development, Stripe-based payment and billing setup, ad-campaign creation and optimization, 24/7 AI customer support, email automation and cold outbound, market and competitor research, and code generation and deployment, iterating on founder feedback. companies.name: Outverse
companies.description: Outverse is an enterprise "service AI operating system" from Outverse Limited, a UK company backed by Seedcamp and Wing Venture Capital. Its platform lets support and operations teams deploy governed AI agents across complex customer-service workflows — email, chat, voice, and API-driven actions — from a single control center. Teams define logic, policies, and human handoffs in natural language SOPs rather than rigid workflow builders, and get observability over every agent decision, tool call, workflow path, and escalation. Outverse integrates with existing CCaaS and CRM stacks (Salesforce, Freshdesk, Genesys, Twilio, Talkdesk) and offers voice agents that verify identity, retrieve data, apply policy, and resolve calls end to end. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and Wing Venture Capital.

companies.name: Praxis AI (Vortexify)
companies.description: Praxis AI is a Y Combinator (Fall 2024) company that now operates as Vortexify (vortexify.ai). Vortexify is an AI-native platform that generates operational software directly from a company's data: teams connect data sources through 20+ prebuilt connectors (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, NetSuite, Oracle, S3, Azure Blob, Google Sheets/Drive, SharePoint and more), describe requirements in plain English, and AI agents plan, code, test and deploy backend logic plus custom frontends with no infrastructure to manage. The platform emphasizes building complete apps on operational data rather than just dashboards, with built-in scheduling, serverless compute execution, role-based access control, audit logs, sandboxed environments, token-based authentication, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Praxis AI was founded by Aditya Tewari (ex-Palantir) and Ransika Liyanage (ex-Tesla, GM, Deloitte), originally focused on manufacturing-specific AI agents for predicting and preventing machine failures. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator. Vortexify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI specification.

companies.name: Prenetics
companies.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

companies.name: AZmed

This removes manual copy-paste and data-entry work from quality control, cutting documentation time by up to 70-90% and reducing errors while creating a unified data foundation that connects OEMs and suppliers. Since launching in December 2024 the software has been adopted by more than 100 SMEs across aerospace, medical devices and mechanical engineering. CERPRO is a Techstars portfolio company and raised a ~EUR 2M pre-seed round in 2025. The product is delivered as a cloud SaaS platform (platform.cerpro.io) hosted on AWS in Germany, with an ISO 27001 certified, GDPR/BDSG-compliant data-security posture.

Core platform capabilities include AI candidate generation, multi-property co-optimization, virtual plate design, experimental data management with full versioning and audit trails, task orchestration (analyze data, diversify, engineer, select, search, train) across modalities including antibodies/mAbs, enzymes, vaccines, therapeutic peptides, and food ingredients, plus a Custom Predictors framework letting customers plug in their own ML models. Cradle is sold as enterprise SaaS to R&D organizations — disclosed customers and partners include Johnson & Johnson Janssen, Bayer, Novozymes/Novonesis, and Twist Bioscience, with the platform serving six of the top 25 global pharma companies and over 50 active R&D programs. The company has raised approximately $115M to date across a seed round (Index Ventures, 2022), a $24M Series A (Index Ventures, 2023), and a $73M Series B (IVP, 2024). Co-founders are Stef van Grieken (CEO), Jelle Prins, Elise de Reus, Eli Bixby, and Harmen van Rossum.

Snowflake announced its intent to acquire LeapYear on 2023-02-07 and closed on 2023-02-10 for USD 62.0 million in cash, primarily for talent and developed technology, folding the differential privacy capability into its Global Data Clean Room offering. The company no longer operates independently, leapyear.io is now a Snowflake-controlled redirect, and the only surviving first-party documentation is the Python client API reference on its readthedocs host.

Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. companies.name: Pinokio
companies.description: Pinokio is an open-source desktop application — self-described as an "AI Browser" — that acts as a 1-click launcher for any open-source AI project. Built by independent developer Cocktail Peanut (cocktailpeanut), Pinokio packages a terminal, package managers (Conda, Homebrew, Pip, NPM), and a graphical UI into a single MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with NVIDIA, AMD, and Apple Silicon GPU support. Users install AI apps with one click from a curated "Discover" directory of 160+ vetted scripts spanning image generation, video generation, text-to-speech and voice cloning, large language models, 3D generation, music and audio generation, and face swap. Pinokio is driven by a JSON-based scripting language designed to be both human and machine readable, with primitives like shell.run, fs, input, log, jump, hf (Hugging Face), notify, browser, and json that let publishers describe install and launch flows declaratively. Each script is sandboxed under ~/pinokio with isolated paths and Python virtual environments, and featured scripts must transfer ownership to the Pinokio Factory GitHub organization for admin review. Pinokio is purely client-side open source — there is no public REST API, no hosted commercial offering, and no developer SDK beyond the local script syntax and the desktop app itself.

Hone is distributed as first-party Python packages (hone-io community edition and hone-io-enterprise) exposing scikit-learn-compatible regression and classification wrappers. The company was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company. There is no public REST/HTTP API surface; integration is via the Python SDK.

Altara unifies siloed data in place without migrations, giving agents full operational context across numerical, text, and image sources for semiconductors, advanced materials, batteries, medical devices, specialty chemicals, and industrials. The platform is SOC 2 Type II compliant with encryption, RBAC, SSO, and self-hosted (VPC) or dedicated single-tenant cloud deployment. Altara does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity and security posture as a lead for future enrichment.

companies.name: EZKL
companies.description: EZKL (by Zkonduit Inc.) is a developer-friendly engine for verifiable AI and analytics that generates zero-knowledge proofs (ZK-SNARKs, Halo2) for machine learning model inference. Given a model in ONNX format and sample input, EZKL automatically compiles a proving circuit and produces a cryptographic proof that a computation ran correctly without revealing the underlying private data or model weights. Proofs are verifiable on-chain (EVM-compatible), in the browser, or on edge devices. EZKL ships as a command-line tool, Python and JavaScript (WebAssembly) bindings, and a Rust library, and supports tree-based models, transformers, CNNs, and RNNs. Lilith is its high-performance compute cluster for cloud-scale proof generation. The codebase was audited by Trail of Bits and is developed in the open at github.com/zkonduit/ezkl.

companies.name: SNMP
companies.description: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is the foundational IETF standard for monitoring and managing network devices. SNMP defines a request/response protocol over UDP (ports 161 and 162) for retrieving and altering management variables exposed by agents on routers, switches, servers, UPSs, and other equipment, plus an asynchronous trap/notification channel for event delivery. The protocol family spans three major generations — SNMPv1 (RFC 1157), SNMPv2c (RFC 1901-1908), and the modular SNMPv3 architecture (RFC 3411-3418, extended by RFC 7860 for HMAC-SHA-2 authentication) — and is paired with the Structure of Management Information (SMI) and a vast catalog of MIB modules, most notably the IF-MIB (RFC 2863) for network interfaces. SNMP remains the lingua franca of network monitoring, consumed primarily by NMS platforms such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds, LibreNMS, and Observium, and implemented in open source primarily by the Net-SNMP suite.

companies.name: Runsybil
companies.description: RunSybil is an AI-native autonomous offensive security platform. Sybil — a system of AI agents — continuously penetration tests live applications and infrastructure, finding, exploiting, and validating real vulnerabilities without a human in the loop. It tests live applications black-box by default (no source code required), integrates with GitHub and GitLab to trigger targeted change testing on every code push, and validates every finding through a multi-agent pipeline before it surfaces, aiming to eliminate triage and false positives. RunSybil positions as a replacement for point-in-time penetration testing, legacy DAST/SAST scanners, and bug bounty programs, and also offers white-box testing for deeper codebase exploration. Founded in 2023 by Ari Herbert-Voss (OpenAI's first security hire) and Vlad Ionescu (Offensive Security Tech Lead at Meta), the company raised $40M led by Khosla Ventures and is trusted by security teams at Notion, Cursor, Turbopuffer, Baseten, and Thinking Machines Lab. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface is published at this time.

companies.name: Suno
companies.description: Suno is a Cambridge, Massachusetts-based generative AI music company building a consumer platform that lets anyone create original songs from natural language prompts. The product spans text-to-song generation, vocal and instrumental tracks, style and genre control, stem splitting, audio upload and remixing, lyric writing, and Suno Studio for advanced multi-track editing and custom model tuning. The company runs proprietary foundation models for music generation, the latest being v5.5, and ships consumer subscription plans (Free, Pro, Premier) with commercial usage rights on paid tiers. Founded in 2021 by Mikey Shulman, Georg Kucsko, Martin Camacho, and Keenan Freyberg, Suno closed a $250M Series C in November 2025 at a $2.45B valuation led by Menlo Ventures with participation from NVentures, Hallwood Media, Lightspeed, and Matrix. The company has announced a partnership with Warner Music Group. Suno does not publish an official developer API or SDK; the consumer surface is web and mobile applications authenticated via account login, and any third-party "Suno API" offerings are unofficial reverse-engineered wrappers. The suno-ai GitHub organization hosts the open-source Bark text-to-audio model and supporting tooling rather than a Suno product SDK.

Founded by Sebastian Thrun out of the Stanford CS221 free online AI course in 2011, Udacity pioneered the Nanodegree credential and partnered with industry leaders (AWS, Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Mercedes-Benz) to co-develop curriculum. In 2024 Accenture acquired Udacity for approximately $1B and folded the platform into LearnVantage, Accenture's enterprise learning and skilling business. Udacity reports 25M+ learners globally and remains best known for its Self-Driving Car, Deep Learning, and Generative AI Nanodegrees, with hands-on projects reviewed by human mentors and career services. Udacity does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — enterprise customers integrate via Accenture LearnVantage sales channels rather than self-service APIs. Its public GitHub organization (github.com/udacity) hosts 1,100+ open-source classroom and course-content repositories (e.g. deep-learning-v2-pytorch, self-driving-car, cd13303-genai-c1-classroom) used as Nanodegree exercises, not as official platform APIs.

companies.name: Vake
companies.description: VAKE is a Norwegian maritime domain awareness company that detects, identifies, and tracks "dark vessels" from space. The VAKE platform fuses satellite imagery, AIS signals, and machine learning to reveal hidden vessel activity at sea for governments and industry. Its three products are Pathfinder, which reconstructs a vessel's past, present, and predicted movements and searches satellite imagery for vessels that go AIS-dark; Overwatch, which monitors an Area of Interest around ports, critical infrastructure, and economic zones to surface unreported activity such as illegal fishing, transshipments, and spoofing; and Clearview, a machine-learning service that identifies dark-vessel observations in multispectral satellite imagery against a global vessel-signature database spanning 2016 to today. The platform is delivered as a web application (studio.vake.ai) backed by a private API (api.nemme.io); onboarding is sales-led rather than self-serve.

companies.name: Certivity

Its product, Certivity Core, turns complex regulations, standards, and internal documents into structured, machine-readable, engineering-ready requirements with full traceability and real-time monitoring of legal changes across 50+ jurisdictions. The platform digitizes and structures regulatory content from publishers such as ISO, IEC, CEN, CENELEC, ASTM, UL, and SAE using a proprietary ingestion pipeline and a regulatory knowledge graph, and integrates directly into engineering workflows (including Jama Connect) via an official API. Backed by Earlybird, High-Tech Gruenderfonds, UVC Partners, and Almaz Capital, Certivity added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

The platform provides AI-assisted search across operational and maintenance manuals, dynamic data storage and library management, custom workflow and procedure building, real-time task tracking and work-log monitoring, and predictive maintenance and troubleshooting guidance. Kilsar promises measurable outcomes including reduced downtime, faster mean-time-to-repair, and increased equipment uptime. Kilsar is a Techstars-backed company. The study becomes a live simulation of the market that analysts can question and run scenarios against to predict where a market is headed. Investors use Lato for commercial due diligence, expert interviews, market sizing, competitive mapping, customer interviews, pricing studies, deal sourcing, inbound screening and portfolio value creation, compressing research that traditionally costs hundreds of thousands of dollars and takes weeks into hours. By observing which vulnerable code actually executes at runtime, Oligo proves exploitability and reduces vulnerability noise by up to 90-99%, letting teams prioritize the small fraction of findings that are truly reachable. The platform covers apps, workloads, hosts, and cloud infrastructure, and adds runtime protection for AI agents and models. Oligo is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and counts organizations such as Databricks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Instacart, and Cresta among its customers. companies.name: MosaicML
companies.description: MosaicML was a San Francisco-based foundation model training company founded in 2021 by Naveen Rao and Hanlin Tang to make large-scale model training faster and cheaper through algorithmic and systems efficiency. Databricks acquired MosaicML in July 2023 for approximately $1.3 billion and folded the team and platform into Databricks Mosaic AI Research. The MosaicML training platform is now delivered as Databricks Mosaic AI Training (pretraining and finetuning), and the original mosaicml.com domain redirects to the Databricks Mosaic Research microsite. MosaicML's surviving open-source artifacts include Composer (a PyTorch training library with built-in speedup recipes), Streaming (a cloud-native dataset format for efficient distributed training), LLM Foundry (the training code behind Databricks' DBRX foundation model), the Diffusion training stack, and the MCLI command line and Python SDK that orchestrate Pretraining and Finetuning jobs against the managed training service. The Mosaic AI Training service itself is accessed exclusively through the MCLI command line, the mosaicml-cli Python SDK, and Databricks workspace integrations — there is no publicly published REST OpenAPI surface for the training control plane. Commercial access requires a Databricks account; pricing is consumption-based via Databricks DBU billing rather than an independent MosaicML pricing page.

companies.name: Paraglide
companies.description: Paraglide is a British-Swedish AI company building autonomous agents that automate accounts receivable for high-volume B2B finance teams. Its agents handle two-way billing communication across the order-to-cash lifecycle: answering customer billing questions, chasing overdue invoices, resolving disputes and deductions, running collections, operating a supplier portal, and applying cash — integrating with ERPs, CRMs, and billing software to cut Days Sales Outstanding and improve cash flow. Founded in 2025 by Rasmus Areskoug and Andreas Astrom with offices in London and Malmo, Paraglide raised a $5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and DN Capital in January 2026. As of this profile the company is a product/agent platform with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Pienso
companies.description: Pienso is an interactive no-code AI and machine learning platform, founded in 2016 out of MIT by Karthik Dinakar and Birago Jones and headquartered in the Washington, DC / Arlington, VA area. It lets subject-matter experts explore, train, fingerprint, annotate, and deploy deep-learning and large language models over unstructured text — customer calls, emails, documents, and social content — through a point-and-click interface with no coding required. Product capabilities include Ingest, Train & Fingerprint, Annotate, Dataset Analysis, and PromptFactory, applied to use cases such as customer insight, content moderation, document intelligence, and risk detection. Pienso is deployed into the customer's own environment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Gcore, or on-premises — so data never leaves the customer's control, and the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; integration is sales-led and the platform runs as a self-contained system. Backed by Uncork Capital.

The platform centers on three core model families: Segmentation (identifying and measuring microstructural features), Reconstruction (converting 2D micrographs into 3D representations), and Design (optimising microstructural parameters). It is applied across batteries, metals and alloys, composites, ceramics, additive manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, spanning R&D, quality and qualification, and modelling and simulation workflows. Polaron is backed by Speedinvest and research institutions including Imperial College London, Manchester, Oxford, and Cambridge.

companies.name: Eve
companies.description: Eve (eve.legal) is a legal AI platform built by Butler Labs, Inc. for plaintiff law firms. Marketed as "the only legal AI that works your whole case with you," Eve 2.0 is positioned as a proactive AI workforce that spans the full plaintiff case lifecycle — intake and evaluation, pre-litigation drafting (medical chronologies, demand letters), litigation discovery (propounding and responding), and case auditing. The platform is organized around three product surfaces: Eve Agents (intake & evaluation, AI voice agent, medical overviews, demand letters, drafting, propounding discovery, responding to discovery), Eve Auditor (nightly audit of the active caseload for missed value drivers such as TBIs, MRIs ordered but not taken, and mass-tort eligibility), and Eve Analyst (announced as "coming soon"). companies.name: CLAUDE.md
companies.description: CLAUDE.md is the markdown-based project memory format used by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI to give the model persistent, session-spanning instructions about a codebase. CLAUDE.md files are plain markdown that Claude Code loads at the start of every session by walking up the directory tree from the working directory, picking up files at organization-managed, user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project (./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md), and local (./CLAUDE.local.md) scopes. The format supports an @path import syntax for composing files together (up to five hops, relative or absolute), HTML block comments that are stripped before injection, an AGENTS.md import pattern for compatibility with other agents, and a complementary .claude/rules/ directory of path-scoped markdown rules with YAML frontmatter. CLAUDE.md is the human-authored counterpart to Claude Code's auto memory at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/MEMORY.md, which Claude writes itself.

companies.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

companies.name: Generate Biomedicines
companies.description: Generate Biomedicines is a Somerville, Massachusetts therapeutics company pioneering Generative Biology, a machine-learning-driven approach to de novo protein design across antibodies, peptides, enzymes, and gene therapies. Founded out of Flagship Pioneering and chaired by Noubar Afeyan, the company trains generative models on the full compendium of natural protein structures and sequences plus proprietary wet-lab data to design novel protein therapeutics computationally rather than by trial-and-error discovery. Its open-source flagship is Chroma, a programmable diffusion-based generative model for joint protein structure and sequence design published in Nature 2023 ("Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model", doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06728-8) and released on GitHub under Apache 2.0 with pretrained weights available under a custom Chroma Parameters License (free for academic and nonprofit use). Chroma uses equivariant graph neural networks, diffusion modeling, and conditional random fields to sample all-atom protein structures with sub-quadratic complexity, supporting conditional generation via composable Conditioner modules for symmetry, substructure, shape, and secondary-structure constraints. The internal Generate Platform iterates on a "generate, build, measure, learn" loop that pairs in-silico design with high-throughput protein synthesis and characterization; the company reports having generated, built, and tested more than 42,000 proteins. Generate Biomedicines has platform collaborations with Amgen (six programs, January 2022) and Novartis (multiple programs, September 2024) and a CAR T collaboration with Roswell Park. Its clinical pipeline is led by GB-0895, a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody for severe asthma now in Phase 3 (SOLAIRIA study) with a parallel Phase 1 in COPD, plus preclinical programs GB-4362 (anti-free-MMAE for ADC oncology safety) and GB-5267 (MUC16 armored CAR T for ovarian cancer). The company priced its initial public offering in February 2026. Revenue derives from drug development, partner collaborations, and (for Chroma) commercial weights licensing; there is no public developer REST/HTTPS API or SDK for the Generate Platform itself — Chroma is consumed as a Python library installed via pip with model weights downloaded from chroma-weights.generatebiomedicines.com after registering for an API key.

Developers and security teams integrate Mindgard via a public REST API (projects, tests, multi-turn tests, datasets, findings, reconnaissance), a Python CLI (`pip install mindgard`), a Python SDK, a Burp Suite extension, and a GitHub Action for adding red-team checks to MLOps pipelines. The company also maintains and contributes to open-source security tooling including PyRIT integrations, an OpenAI-compatible LLM-Guard proxy, a chatbot API wrapper for testing web chatbots, and proof-of-concept vulnerability demonstrations (document RCE in LangChain agents, hidden audio jailbreaks, prompt-jailbreak demos). The platform is sold as SaaS to general contractors, owners and developers, and consultants working on industrial (data centres, energy, semiconductors), infrastructure (rail, highway, tunnels), and commercial projects, with reported impacts including up to 17% reduction in project duration and 14% labor cost savings. ALICE was founded in 2015 by René Morkos (Stanford PhD) and is backed by Merus Capital, Foundamental, Future Ventures, Lightspeed, Blackhorn Ventures, and Brick and Mortar; in 2026 it announced a formal alliance with McKinsey to deploy generative scheduling on capital projects. companies.name: AutoGen Studio
companies.description: AutoGen Studio is a low-code / no-code developer GUI from Microsoft Research for rapidly prototyping, composing, and debugging multi-agent AI workflows built on the AutoGen framework. Shipped as the `autogenstudio` Python package and launched with `autogenstudio ui`, it serves a FastAPI + React (Gatsby) web app on localhost that exposes four primary interfaces — Team Builder, Playground, Gallery, and Deployment — backed by a SQLModel persistence layer (SQLite by default; any SQLAlchemy-compatible backend such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL via `--database-uri`). The Team Builder offers drag-and-drop and JSON authoring of teams, agents, models, tools, and termination conditions fully aligned with AutoGen AgentChat's declarative component spec; the Playground streams live inter-agent messages and renders the control transition graph; the Gallery imports community components; and the Deployment view exports a team to Python, exposes it as an endpoint, and packages it for Docker. AutoGen Studio is built on AutoGen AgentChat / Core / Extensions and supports any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, local vLLM/Ollama, etc.) via declarative `model_client` configuration, plus MCP tool integration. Authentication is experimental (GitHub OAuth + JWT only). Microsoft explicitly positions AutoGen Studio as a research prototype — not production-ready — and encourages teams that need authn/z, multi-tenancy, sandboxing rigor, or hardened deployment to build directly on the AutoGen framework instead. Companion to the broader AutoGen multi-agent framework, distributed under the Microsoft microsoft/autogen monorepo (CC-BY-4.0 docs, MIT code).

companies.name: Protect AI
companies.description: Protect AI is an AI/ML security company building defensive tooling and open-source security research for the model supply chain, large language model (LLM) applications, and runtime AI workloads. The commercial platform is anchored by three products — Guardian (AI model security and third-party model scanning across PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, Pickle, GGUF, Safetensors, and 35+ formats with Hugging Face, SageMaker, MLflow, S3, Git, and Artifactory integrations), Recon (scalable AI red teaming with an attack library of 450+ known attacks against LLM applications mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10), and Layer (runtime AI security with 27 turnkey policies, eBPF and SDK collection, and DataDog/Splunk/Elastic/PagerDuty integration). Protect AI also stewards a portfolio of widely used open-source AI security projects on GitHub including LLM Guard (input/output scanner toolkit for prompt injection, PII, toxicity, secrets, and data leakage detection), ModelScan (model serialization attack scanner), Rebuff (prompt injection detector, archived May 2025), NB Defense (Jupyter notebook security), AI Exploits (real-world AI/ML vulnerability demonstrations), and Vulnhuntr (LLM-driven autonomous vulnerability discovery), plus the huntr bug bounty platform for AI/ML with over 17,000 security researchers. Protect AI was acquired by Palo Alto Networks in 2025 and is being integrated into the Prisma AIRS AI security platform.
